title.zh: 卷二十五 本紀第二十五 高宗二
title.raw: 卷二十五 本紀第二十五 高宗二 Volume 25 Annals 25: Gaozong 2

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙戌朔，帝在揚州。

translations.literal: Jianyan year 2, spring, first month, day bingxu new moon: the emperor was at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyan 2, spring, bingxu new moon: the court sat at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，錄兩河流亡吏士。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: recorded refugee officials and soldiers from the two Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, clerks enrolled refugee officials and soldiers from the Yellow and Huai country.

sentences.zh: 沿河給流民官田、牛、種。

translations.literal: Along the rivers, allotted official fields, oxen, and seed to displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: Along the rivers they gave displaced families state land, oxen, and seed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金人陷鄧州，安撫劉汲死之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Jin took Deng prefecture; pacification commissioner Liu Ji died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Jin seized Deng; Liu Ji, who held the pacification, fell with the city.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置行在榷貨務。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: established a transit-office monopoly bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the court opened a transit monopoly bureau for state trade.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，金人犯東京，宗澤遣將擊卻之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Jin struck Dongjing; Zong Ze sent generals and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Jin raiders hit Dongjing; Zong Ze’s generals threw them out again.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復明法新科。

translations.literal: Day guisi: restored the new Ming-law examination.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Ming-law civil examination was revived.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詣壽寧寺，謁祖宗神主。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: went to Shouning Temple and bowed before the ancestral spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the emperor entered Shouning Temple and bowed to the ancestral tablets.

sentences.zh: 乙未，金人破永興軍，前河東經制副使傅亮以兵降，經略使唐重、副總管楊宗閔、提舉軍馬陳迪、轉運副使桑景詢、判官曾謂、提點刑獄郭忠孝、經略司主管機宜文字王尚及其子建中俱死之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Jin broke Yongxing army; former Hedong circuit deputy commissioner Fu Liang surrendered with troops; circuit commissioner Tang Zhong, deputy commander Yang Zongmin, horse-raising intendant Chen Di, transport deputy Sang Jingxun, judge Zeng Wei, judicial intendant Guo Zhongxiao, circuit staff officer Wang Shang and his son Jianzhong all died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Jin overran Yongxing; Fu Liang, once Hedong’s deputy commissioner, turned with his men; Tang Zhong, Yang Zongmin, Chen Di, Sang Jingxun, Zeng Wei, Guo Zhongxiao, Wang Shang, and Wang Shang’s son Jianzhong died in the ruin.

sentences.zh: 東平府兵馬鈐轄孔彥舟叛，渡淮犯黃州，守臣趙令峸拒之。

translations.literal: Dongping circuit horse-and-army controller Kong Yanzhou rebelled, crossed the Huai, struck Huang prefecture, and defender Zhao Lingyi held him off.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yanzhou, controller at Dongping, rebelled, crossed the Huai, and struck Huang; Zhao Lingyi barred the city.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔：「自今犯枉法自盜贓者，中書籍其姓名，罪至徒者，永不錄用。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: an edict said, “From now on, whoever commits the crimes of bending law or stealing in office shall have his name entered in the Secretariat register; when the sentence reaches penal servitude, he shall never be employed again.”
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, an edict: bend the law or steal in office, and the Secretariat will record your name—reach penal servitude, and you never serve again.

sentences.zh: 金人陷均州，守臣楊彥明遁去。

translations.literal: Jin took Jun prefecture; defender Yang Yanming fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Jun; Yang Yanming ran.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金人陷房州。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Jin took Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Fang fell to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張遇焚真州。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Zhang Yu burned Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhang Yu put Zhen to the torch.

sentences.zh: 秘閣修撰孫昭遠為亂兵所害。

translations.literal: Hanlin exposition compiler Sun Zhaoyuan was killed by mutinous soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Zhaoyuan, Hanlin exposition compiler, died at the hands of mutineers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣主客員外郎謝亮為陝西撫諭使兼宣諭使，持詔賜夏國。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: sent Chief of Guests junior director Xie Liang as Shaanxi soothing-and-instruction commissioner and also instruction commissioner, bearing an edict to bestow on Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Xie Liang went west as soothing commissioner and instruction envoy, carrying an edict for Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 張遇陷鎮江府，守臣錢伯言棄城走。

translations.literal: Zhang Yu took Zhenjiang prefecture; defender Qian Boyan abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yu seized Zhenjiang; Qian Boyan abandoned the walls and fled.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，內侍邵成章坐輒言人臣除名、南雄州編管。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: eunuch Shao Chengzhang, for presuming to speak on removing a minister, was struck from the rolls and assigned to Nanxiong prefecture under guard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the eunuch Shao Chengzhang, who had spoken out on a minister’s removal, was struck from office and sent under guard to Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 金人陷鄭州，通判趙伯振死之。

translations.literal: Jin took Zheng prefecture; vice prefect Zhao Bozhen died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng fell; vice prefect Zhao Bozhen died with the city.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金帥窩裏嗢陷濰州，又陷青州，尋棄去。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Jin commander Wolibu took Wei prefecture, then Qing, and soon abandoned them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wolibu took Wei and Qing, then cast them aside and marched on.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔諭流民、潰兵之為盜賊者，釋其罪。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict told displaced people and scattered soldiers who had turned bandit that their crimes were forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, an edict forgave refugees and routed men who had taken to banditry.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禁諸將引潰兵入蜀，置大散關使以審驗之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: forbade generals to lead routed troops into Shu; established a Da San Pass commissioner to examine them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, generals were forbidden to pour routed men into Shu; a Da San Pass officer was set to vet every crossing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣考功員外郎傅雱為淮東京東西撫諭使。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: sent Evaluation Bureau junior director Fu Yun as Huai-Dong and Jing-Dong soothing commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Fu Yun was sent to soothe Huai-Dong and Jing-Dong.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，王淵招降張遇，以所部萬人隸韓世忠。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Wang Yuan induced Zhang Yu to surrender; his ten thousand men were placed under Han Shizhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Wang Yuan talked Zhang Yu down; ten thousand of his men passed to Han Shizhong.

sentences.zh: 改授顯謨閣直學士孟忠厚為常德軍承宣使。

translations.literal: Meng Zhonghou, straight academician of the Xianmo Pavilion, was reassigned military commissioner of Changde army.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhonghou, Xianmo straight academician, was made Changde’s military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔凡後族毋任侍從官，著為令。

translations.literal: An edict: imperial affines were never again to hold attendance office; this was made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred the empress’s kin from attendance posts—henceforth law.

sentences.zh: 金人焚鄧州。

translations.literal: Jin burned Deng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin burned Deng.

sentences.zh: 是月，以中奉大夫劉豫知濟南府。

translations.literal: This month, Liu Yu, grand master of court, was made prefect of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Yu, grand master of court, took Jinan.

sentences.zh: 金人陷潁昌府，守臣孫默為所殺。

translations.literal: Jin took Yingchang prefecture; defender Sun Mo was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang fell; Sun Mo was slain.

sentences.zh: 經制司僚屬王擇仁復永興軍。

translations.literal: Circuit staff officer Wang Zereng recovered Yongxing army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zereng, on the circuit staff, retook Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 金人陷秦州，經略使李復降；

translations.literal: Jin took Qin prefecture; circuit commissioner Li Fu surrendered;
translations.idiomatic: Qin fell; Li Fu, the circuit commissioner, surrendered;

sentences.zh: 又犯熙河，經略使張深遣兵馬都監劉惟輔與戰於新店，敗之，斬其帥黑鋒。

translations.literal: they also struck Xihe; circuit commissioner Zhang Shen sent horse-and-army inspector Liu Weifu to fight at Xindian, defeated them, and beheaded their commander Heifeng.
translations.idiomatic: then they probed Xihe; Zhang Shen sent Liu Weifu to Xindian, broke them, and took the commander Heifeng’s head.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，金人再犯東京，宗澤遣統制閻中立等拒之，中立戰死。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: Jin again struck Dongjing; Zong Ze sent controller Yan Zhongli to hold them; Zhongli died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingchen: the Jin hit Dongjing again; Zong Ze sent Yan Zhongli; Zhongli died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 戊午，移耿南仲于臨江軍。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Geng Nanzhong was moved to Linjiang army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Geng Nanzhong was exiled to Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 金人陷唐州。

translations.literal: Jin took Tang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tang fell to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，安化軍節度副使宇文虛中應詔使絕域，復中大夫，召赴行在。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Anhua army deputy military commissioner Yuwen Xuzhong answered the edict as envoy to distant lands, was restored to grand master of court, and was summoned to the transit court.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yuwen Xuzhong, summoned as envoy beyond the pale, regained grand master of court and was called to the transit court.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，罷市易務。

translations.literal: Day guihai: abolished the market-trade bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the market-trade bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金人犯滑州，宗澤遣張捴救之，戰死。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Jin struck Hua prefecture; Zong Ze sent Zhang Ce to rescue it; Ce died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Jin struck Hua; Zong Ze sent Zhang Ce; Ce died in the relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，澤遣判官范世延等表請帝還闕。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Ze sent judge Fan Shiyan and others in a memorial begging the emperor to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zong Ze’s judge Fan Shiyan and others begged the throne to return north.

sentences.zh: 河北賊楊進等詣澤降。

translations.literal: Hebei bandits Yang Jin and others came to Ze and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei bandits led by Yang Jin surrendered to Zong Ze.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復延康、述古殿直學士為端明、樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: restored Yankang and Shugu hall straight academics to Duanyi and Privy Council straight academics.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Yankang and Shugu straight posts were restored to Duanyi and Privy Council straight ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔自今犯枉法自盜贓罪至死者，籍其貲。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an edict said that from now on, those guilty of bending law or stealing in office unto death would have their property registered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict: bend law or steal in office to the death penalty, and your goods are forfeit to the register.

sentences.zh: 壬申，赦福州叛卒張員等。

translations.literal: Day renshen: amnestied the mutinous soldiers of Fuzhou led by Zhang Yuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Fuzhou’s mutineer Zhang Yuan and his men were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，金人陷蔡州，執守臣閻孝忠。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Jin took Cai prefecture and seized defender Yan Xiaozhong.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Cai fell; Yan Xiaozhong was taken alive.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金人陷淮寧府，守臣向子韶死之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Jin took Huaining prefecture; defender Xiang Zishao died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Huaining fell; Xiang Zishao died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣王貺等充金國軍前通問使。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: sent Wang Kuang and others as envoys to inquire before the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wang Kuang and others were sent to parley before the Jin host.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，責降知鎮江府趙子崧為單州團練副使、南雄州安置。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: demoted former Zhenjiang prefect Zhao Zisong to Huaihua army deputy training commissioner and assigned him to Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zhao Zisong, who had held Zhenjiang, was cut to Huaihua deputy training commissioner and settled at Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 己卯，奪秘書正字胡珵官，送梧州編管。

translations.literal: Day jimao: stripped Secretariat rectifier Hu Peng of office and sent him under guard to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hu Peng lost his rectifier’s title and was sent under guard to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 朝奉大夫劉正彥應詔使絕域，授武德大夫、威州刺史，尋為禦營右軍副統制。

translations.literal: Court gentleman Liu Zhengyan answered the edict as envoy to distant lands, was made military grandee of martial virtue and prefect of Wei, and soon made deputy controller of the Imperial Camp right army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhengyan, court gentleman, went as envoy beyond the pale, took martial virtue grandee and Wei prefect, and soon became deputy of the Imperial Camp right army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以王淵為向德軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: made Wang Yuan military commissioner of Xiangde army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Yuan was made Xiangde’s military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，武功大夫、和州防禦使馬擴奔真定五馬山砦聚兵，得皇弟信王榛於民間，奉之總制諸砦。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: martial merit grandee and Hezhou defense commissioner Ma Kuo fled to Zhending’s Wuma Mountain stockade, gathered troops, found Imperial Brother Trustworthy Prince Zhen among the people, and set him over all the stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Ma Kuo, martial merit grandee and Hezhou defender, fled to Wuma Mountain above Zhending, raised men, found Trustworthy Prince Zhen in hiding, and set the prince over every stockade.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔京畿、京東西、河北、淮南路置振華軍八萬人。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered eight myriad men for pacification armies in the capital districts, Jing-Dong, Jing-Xi, Hebei, and Huai-South circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, an edict raised eighty thousand men for pacification armies across the capital districts, Jing, Hebei, and Huai-South.

sentences.zh: 是月，成都守臣盧法原修城成。

translations.literal: This month, Chengdu defender Lu Fayuan finished repairing the walls.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chengdu’s Lu Fayuan finished the city walls.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，金人陷中山府。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao: Jin took Zhongshan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinmao: Zhongshan fell.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔諸路安撫使許便宜節制官吏。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict allowed circuit pacification commissioners to control officials at need without prior approval.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, pacification commissioners were allowed to command local officials as urgency required.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，初立《大小使臣呈試弓馬出官格》，先閱試，然後奏補。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: for the first time established regulations for great and small civil and military officials to present bow and horse before appointment—trial first, then memorial for posting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, civil and military appointees were for the first time made to trial bow and horse before posting—test first, memorial after.

sentences.zh: 粘罕焚西京去。

translations.literal: Nianhan burned Xijing and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Nianhan burned Xijing and drew off.

sentences.zh: 庚子，河南統制官翟進復西京，宗澤奏進為京西北路安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Henan controller Zhai Jin recovered Xijing; Zong Ze memorialized making Jin Huai-Northwest pacification and planning commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhai Jin retook Xijing; Zong Ze asked that Jin be made Huai-Northwest pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遙授尚書右僕射何㮚為觀文殿大學士，中書侍郎陳過庭為資政殿大學士，同知樞密院事聶昌為資政殿大學士，並主管宮觀。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: by distant appointment made Right Vice Director He 㮚 a Grand Academician of the Observant Literary Hall, Vice Director of the Chancellery Chen Guoting a Grand Academician of the Policy Hall, and Associate Privy Councilor Nie Chang a Policy Hall grand academician, all supervising palace offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, He 㮚 was named Observant Literary grand academician, Chen Guoting Policy Hall grand academician, and Nie Chang Policy Hall grand academician, all titular palace supervisors—by distant appointment.

sentences.zh: 時㮚已卒于金，昌為人所殺，朝遷未之知。

translations.literal: By then He 㮚 had already died in Jin hands; Chang had been killed by men— the court had not yet learned it.
translations.idiomatic: He 㮚 was already dead in Jin hands; Nie Chang had been murdered—the transit court did not yet know.

sentences.zh: 過庭亦在金軍中。

translations.literal: Guoting was also in the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guoting, too, was trapped in the Jin camp.

sentences.zh: 丁未，罷內外權局官之不應法者。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: abolished inner and outer provisional bureau posts that did not accord with law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, unlawful inner and outer provisional bureaus were swept away.

sentences.zh: 遣楊應誠為大金、高麗國信使。

translations.literal: Sent Yang Yingcheng as credentialed envoy to Great Jin and Koryŏ.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingcheng was sent as credentialed envoy to Jin and Koryŏ.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張員等復作亂，擁眾突城出，命本路提點刑獄李芘討捕之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Zhang Yuan and others rebelled again, led a mob to burst out of the city, and the circuit judicial intendant Li Pi was ordered to hunt them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhang Yuan rebelled again, broke out of Fuzhou with a mob, and Li Pi was ordered to hunt him down.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以范瓊權同主管侍衛步軍司公事，屯真州。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: made Fan Qiong acting associate supervisor of the Palace Guard foot army, encamped at Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Fan Qiong was made acting associate over the Palace Guard footmen and camped at Zhen.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人陷鳳翔府，守臣劉清臣棄城去；

translations.literal: This month, Jin took Fengxiang prefecture; defender Liu Qingchen abandoned the city;
translations.idiomatic: That month Fengxiang fell; Liu Qingchen fled;

sentences.zh: 又犯涇原，經略使統制官曲端遣將拒戰，敗之，金兵走同、華。

translations.literal: they also struck Jingyuan; circuit commissioner and controller Qu Duan sent generals to resist, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew toward Tong and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: then they probed Jingyuan; Qu Duan’s generals beat them back toward Tong and Hua.

sentences.zh: 石壕尉李彥仙舉兵復陝州。

translations.literal: Shihao district captain Li Yansian raised troops and recovered Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yansian, captain at Shihao, raised men and retook Shan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，詔文臣從官至牧守、武臣管軍至遙郡，各舉所知二人。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingchen: an edict ordered civil officials from attendance rank to prefect, and military officials from army command to distant commandery, each to recommend two men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingchen: every civil officer to prefect, every commander to distant commandery, was to name two men worth knowing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禁州縣責鄰保代輸逃戶稅役。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: forbade prefectures and counties to make neighboring guarantors pay taxes and corvée for fugitive households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, counties were forbidden to dun neighbors for fugitives’ taxes and labor.

sentences.zh: 宗澤遣將趙世興復滑州。

translations.literal: Zong Ze sent general Zhao Shixing to recover Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Ze sent Zhao Shixing to retake Hua.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，翟進以兵襲金帥兀室於河南，兵敗，其子亮死之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhai Jin led troops to strike Jin commander Wushi in Henan, was defeated, and his son Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhai Jin struck Wushi in Henan, was broken, and his son Liang fell.

sentences.zh: 進又率御營統制韓世忠、京城都巡檢使丁進等兵戰於文家寺，又敗，世忠收餘兵南歸。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhai Jin again led Imperial Camp controller Han Shizhong, capital patrol commissioner Ding Jin, and others to fight at Wenjia Temple, was defeated again, and Shizhong gathered the remnant and marched south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhai Jin led Han Shizhong, Ding Jin, and others to Wenjia Temple, was broken again, and Shizhong gathered what was left and marched south.

sentences.zh: 兀室復入西京，尋棄去。

translations.literal: Wushi re-entered Xijing and soon abandoned it.
translations.idiomatic: Wushi re-entered Xijing, then cast it aside.

sentences.zh: 隴右都護張嚴及金人戰於五里坡，敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Longyou protector Zhang Yan fought Jin at Wulipu, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yan, Longyou protector, fought at Wulipu, was routed, and died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，金人入洺州。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Jin entered Luo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Jin entered Luo.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，軍賊孫琦焚隨州。

translations.literal: Day renchen: army bandit Sun Qi burned Sui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Sun Qi, an army bandit, burned Sui.

sentences.zh: 癸未，入唐州。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: entered Tang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, he entered Tang.

sentences.zh: 信王榛遣馬擴來奏事。

translations.literal: Trustworthy Prince Zhen sent Ma Kuo to report at court.
translations.idiomatic: Trustworthy Prince Zhen sent Ma Kuo to the transit court with word.

sentences.zh: 是月，以榛為河外兵馬都元帥，擴為元帥府馬步軍都總管。

translations.literal: This month, Zhen was made commander-in-chief of armies beyond the river; Kuo was made grand marshal of horse and foot of the commander’s headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhen was made commander beyond the river; Ma Kuo was made his horse-and-foot grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，許景衡罷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiyou: Xu Jingheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yiyou: Xu Jingheng left office.

sentences.zh: 孫琦犯德安府。

translations.literal: Sun Qi struck Dean prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Qi struck Dean.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命參酌元祐科舉條制，立詩賦、經義分試法。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: ordered consultation on Yuanyou examination regulations and established separate poetry-and-fu and classics-meaning examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yuanyou examination rules were weighed and poetry-and-fu and classics-meaning were split into separate tests.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以翰林學士朱勝非為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: made Hanlin academician Zhu Shengfei Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhu Shengfei, Hanlin academician, became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以金兵渡河，遣韓世忠、宗澤等逆戰。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because Jin troops had crossed the river, sent Han Shizhong, Zong Ze, and others to meet them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, with Jin already across the river, Han Shizhong, Zong Ze, and others were sent to meet them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曲赦河北、陝西、京東路。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: partial amnesty for Hebei, Shaanxi, and Jing-Dong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Jing-Dong received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 福建轉運判官謝如意執張員等六人，誅之。

translations.literal: Fujian transport vice judge Xie Ruyi seized Zhang Yuan and six others and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Ruyi, Fujian transport vice judge, seized Zhang Yuan and six men and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復命宇文虛中為資政殿大學士，充金國祈請使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: again appointed Yuwen Xuzhong Policy Hall grand academician and credentialed Jin supplication envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Yuwen Xuzhong was again Policy Hall grand academician and Jin supplication envoy.

sentences.zh: 賊靳賽寇光山縣。

translations.literal: Bandit Jin Sai raided Guangshan county.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Jin Sai raided Guangshan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，河北制置使王彥部兵渡河，屯滑州之沙店。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Hebei planning commissioner Wang Yan led troops across the river and encamped at Shadian in Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wang Yan of Hebei planning crossed the river and camped at Hua’s Shadian.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，張愨薨。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhang Chuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Chuo died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金帥婁宿陷絳州。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Jin commander Lousu took Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Lousu took Jiang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，復置兩浙、福建提舉市舶司。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: restored the maritime-trade intendant bureaus of the two Zhe circuits and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, maritime-trade intendancies for the two Zhe circuits and Fujian were restored.

sentences.zh: 己酉，秀州卒徐明等作亂，執守臣朱芾，迎前守趙叔近復領州事。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Xiuzhou soldiers Xu Ming and others mutinied, seized defender Zhu Fei, and welcomed former prefect Zhao Shujin back to head the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Xu Ming and Xiuzhou mutineers seized Zhu Fei and brought back Zhao Shujin as prefect.

sentences.zh: 命禦營中軍統制張俊討之。

translations.literal: Ordered Imperial Camp middle-army controller Zhang Jun to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun, middle-army controller, was ordered to crush them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷借諸路職田。

translations.literal: Day guichou: abolished borrowing from circuit salary fields.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, borrowing from circuit salary fields was ended.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，權罷邛州鑄錢，增印錢引。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: provisionally halted Qiongzhou coin casting and increased printing of paper money notes.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yimao: Qiongzhou casting was halted and paper notes were printed in greater number.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，建州卒葉濃等作亂，寇福州。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Jianzhou soldiers Ye Nong and others mutinied and raided Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Ye Nong and Jianzhou mutineers raided Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，親慮囚。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the emperor personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張俊至秀州，殺趙叔近，執徐明斬之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Jun reached Xiuzhou, killed Zhao Shujin, seized Xu Ming, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Jun reached Xiuzhou, killed Zhao Shujin, seized Xu Ming, and cut off his head.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，葉濃陷福州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Ye Nong took Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Ye Nong took Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔江、浙沿流州軍練水軍，造戰艦。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict ordered Yangtze and Zhejiang riverine prefectures and armies to train river troops and build warships.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, river prefectures along the Yangtze and Zhe were ordered to drill water armies and build war junks.

sentences.zh: 京畿、淮甸蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts in the capital districts and Huai belt.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts blackened the capital districts and the Huai belt.

sentences.zh: 是月，以知延安府王庶節制陝西六路軍馬，涇原經略使統制官曲端為節制司都統制。

translations.literal: This month, Yan’an prefect Wang Shu was made controller of Shaanxi’s six circuits; Jingyuan circuit commissioner and controller Qu Duan was made controller headquarters commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Shu of Yan’an was set over Shaanxi’s six circuits; Qu Duan of Jingyuan became his headquarters commander.

sentences.zh: 永興軍經略使郭琰逐王擇仁，擇仁奔興元。

translations.literal: Yongxing circuit commissioner Guo Yan drove out Wang Zereng; Zereng fled to Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yan of Yongxing drove out Wang Zereng; Zereng fled to Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，葉濃入寧德縣，復還建州，命張俊同兩浙提點刑獄趙哲率兵討之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiashen: Ye Nong entered Ningde county, then returned to Jianzhou; Zhang Jun and the two Zhe judicial intendant Zhao Zhe were ordered to lead troops against him.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiashen: Ye Nong struck Ningde, then fell back on Jianzhou; Zhang Jun and Zhao Zhe of the two Zhe were sent to hunt him.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔吏部審量京官，非政和以後進書頌及直赴殿試人，乃聽參選。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: an edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel to measure capital officials—only those who had not entered by Jingkang-era flattery, praise books, or direct palace examination might stand for selection.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Ministry was to vet capital officials—none who had bought Jingkang favor with praise or direct palace tests might stand for office.

sentences.zh: 宗澤薨。

translations.literal: Zong Ze died.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Ze died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔百官坐祭京、王黼擬授而廢者，許自新復用。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict said officials who had lost office for attending sacrifices to Cai Jing and Wang Fu might petition to be restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, officials cashiered for mourning Cai Jing and Wang Fu were allowed to petition for restoration.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁軍中抉目刳心之刑。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: forbade gouging out eyes and cutting out hearts in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the army was forbidden to gouge eyes or cut out hearts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，選江、浙州軍正兵、土兵六之一赴行在。

translations.literal: Day renchen: selected one man in six from regular and local troops of Jiang and Zhe prefectures and armies for the transit court.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, one man in six from Jiang and Zhe regulars and militia was drafted to the transit court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以郭仲荀為京城副留守。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: made Guo Zhongxun deputy capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Guo Zhongxun was made deputy capital garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，錄內外諸軍將士功。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: recorded merit of inner and outer army officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, merit rolls were opened for every army, inner and outer.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以春霖、夏旱蝗，詔監司、郡守條上闕政，州郡災甚者蠲田賦。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: because of spring floods, summer drought, and locusts, an edict ordered surveillance commissioners and prefects to list neglected government; where disaster was severe, field taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, spring floods, summer drought, and locusts moved the throne to demand neglected government from every commissioner and prefect—where ruin was worst, field tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以降授北京留守杜充復樞密直學士，為開封尹、東京留守。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: restored demoted former Beijing garrison commander Du Chong to Privy Council straight academician, made him Kaifeng intendant and Dongjing garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Du Chong, once demoted from Beijing, regained Privy Council straight rank and was made Kaifeng intendant and Dongjing garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，初鑄禦寶三。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiayin: for the first time cast three imperial seals.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiayin: three imperial seals were cast for the first time.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禦集英殿策試禮部進士。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: in the Hall of Collecting Excellence the emperor examined presented civil-service graduates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the emperor examined graduates in the Hall of Collecting Excellence.

sentences.zh: 罷殿中侍御史馬伸，尋責濮州。

translations.literal: Dismissed Palace Censor Ma Shen; soon demoted him to Pu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Censor Ma Shen was dismissed and soon sent down to Pu.

sentences.zh: 河北、京東捉殺使李成叛。

translations.literal: Hebei and Jing-Dong arrest-and-kill commissioner Li Cheng rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cheng, Hebei and Jing-Dong arrest commissioner, turned rebel.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，犯宿州。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: struck Su prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, he struck Su.

sentences.zh: 是月，二帝徙居韓州。

translations.literal: This month, the two emperors were moved to Han prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huizong and Qinzong were moved to Han.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，丁進叛，復寇淮西。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: Ding Jin rebelled and again raided Huai-West.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiashen: Ding Jin rebelled and raided Huai-West again.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜禮部進士李易以下四百五十一人及第、出身，特奏名進士皆許調官。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: bestowed passage and office on presented graduates led by Li Yi and four hundred fifty-one others; specially presented graduates were all allowed assignment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Yi and four hundred fifty-one graduates passed; specially presented men were all allowed posts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，召侍從所舉褚宗諤等二十一人驛赴行在。

translations.literal: Day renchen: summoned twenty-one men recommended by attendance officials, including Chu Zong’e, by post horse to the transit court.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, twenty-one men recommended from attendance, including Chu Zong’e, were rushed to court by post horse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，金人陷冀州，將官李政死之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Jin took Ji prefecture; officer Li Zheng died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Ji fell; officer Li Zheng died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金人再犯永興軍，經略使郭琰棄城，退保義穀。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Jin again struck Yongxing; circuit commissioner Guo Yan abandoned the city and fell back to Yigu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Jin hit Yongxing again; Guo Yan abandoned the walls and fell back to Yigu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，陝西節制司兵官賀師範及金人戰于八公原，敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Shaanxi controller staff officer He Shifan fought Jin at Bagong Plain, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, He Shifan of the Shaanxi controller staff fought at Bagong Plain, was broken, and died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復所減京官奉。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: restored the reduced salaries of capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, capital officials’ cut salaries were restored.

sentences.zh: 丁未，東京留守統制官薛廣及金人戰於相州，敗死。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Dongjing garrison controller Xue Guang fought Jin at Xiang prefecture, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Xue Guang of Dongjing garrison fought at Xiang, was routed, and died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，郭三益薨。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Guo Sanyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Guo Sanyi died.

sentences.zh: 是秋，窩裏嗢、撻懶破五馬山砦，信王榛不知所終。

translations.literal: That autumn, Wolibu and Tadan broke Wuma Mountain stockade; Trustworthy Prince Zhen’s end was unknown.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Wolibu and Tadan broke Wuma Mountain; Trustworthy Prince Zhen vanished.

sentences.zh: 馬擴軍敗於北京之清平。

translations.literal: Ma Kuo’s army was defeated at Qingping in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Kuo’s army was broken at Beijing’s Qingping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，命揚州浚隍修城。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: ordered Yangzhou’s moat dug and walls repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiayin: Yangzhou was ordered to dig its moat and mend its walls.

sentences.zh: 閱江、淮州郡水軍。

translations.literal: Reviewed river troops of Jiang and Huai prefectures and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: River troops of Jiang and Huai were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 楊應誠還自高麗。

translations.literal: Yang Yingcheng returned from Koryŏ.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingcheng returned from Koryŏ.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣劉光世討李成。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: sent Liu Guangshi to suppress Li Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Liu Guangshi was sent against Li Cheng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禁江、浙閉糴。

translations.literal: Day renxu: forbade Jiang and Zhe from shutting grain sales.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Jiang and Zhe were forbidden to shut grain markets.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，粘罕圍濮州，遣韓世忠、範瓊領兵至東平、開德府，分道拒戰，又命馬擴援之。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Nianhan besieged Pu prefecture; Han Shizhong and Fan Qiong were sent with troops to Dongping and Kaide prefecture to resist on separate routes; Ma Kuo was also ordered to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Nianhan besieged Pu; Han Shizhong and Fan Qiong were sent to Dongping and Kaide on separate roads; Ma Kuo was ordered up as relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命孟忠厚奉隆祐太后幸杭州。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: ordered Meng Zhonghou to escort the Empress Dowager Longyou to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Meng Zhonghou was ordered to escort Empress Dowager Longyou to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 楊進復叛，攻汝、洛，命翟進擊於鳴皋山，翟進戰死。

translations.literal: Yang Jin rebelled again, struck Ru and Luo; Zhai Jin was ordered to strike at Minggao Mountain; Zhai Jin died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jin rebelled again and struck Ru and Luo; Zhai Jin was sent to Minggao Mountain and died in the fight.

sentences.zh: 丙子，罷吏部審量崇甯、大觀以來濫賞，止令自陳。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: abolished Ministry review of Chongning and Daguan inflated rewards; only self-report was required.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Ministry review of Chongning and Daguan inflated rewards was ended—self-report only.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉正彥擊丁進，降之。

translations.literal: This month, Liu Zhengyan struck Ding Jin and induced him to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Zhengyan struck Ding Jin and talked him down.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳朔，提舉嵩山崇福宮李綱責授單州團練副使、萬安軍安置。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi new moon: Li Gang, who had tended Song Mountain Chongfu Palace, was demoted to Huaihua army deputy training commissioner and assigned to Wan’an army.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinsi new moon: Li Gang, keeper of Song Mountain Chongfu Palace, was cut to Huaihua deputy training commissioner and sent to Wan’an.

sentences.zh: 劉光世及李成戰於新息縣，成敗走。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi fought Li Cheng at Xinxian; Cheng was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi met Li Cheng at Xinxian; Cheng broke and ran.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王楷遣其臣尹彥頤入見。

translations.literal: Koryŏ King Wang Kai sent his minister Yin Yan’yi to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Koryŏ’s Wang Kai sent Yin Yan’yi to court.

sentences.zh: 金人圍陝州，守臣李彥仙拒戰，卻之。

translations.literal: Jin besieged Shan prefecture; defender Li Yansian resisted and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Shan; Li Yansian held and threw them back.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，金人陷延安府，權知府劉選、總管馬忠皆遁，通判府事魏彥明死之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Jin took Yan’an; acting prefect Liu Xuan and commander Ma Zhong both fled; vice prefect Wei Yanming died in office.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yan’an fell; Liu Xuan and Ma Zhong fled; vice prefect Wei Yanming died where he stood.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，趙哲大破葉濃於建州城下，濃遁而降，復謀為變，張俊禽斬之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zhao Zhe broke Ye Nong heavily below Jianzhou; Nong fled and surrendered, then plotted mutiny again; Zhang Jun seized and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhao Zhe shattered Ye Nong below Jianzhou; Nong fled, surrendered, then plotted again—Zhang Jun took him and cut off his head.

sentences.zh: 乙未，金人陷濮州，執守臣楊粹中，又陷開德府，守臣王棣死之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Jin took Pu prefecture and seized defender Yang Cuizhong; also took Kaide; defender Wang Di died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Pu fell and Yang Cuizhong was taken; Kaide followed; Wang Di died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 以魏行可充金國軍前通問使。

translations.literal: Made Wei Xingke credentialed envoy to inquire before the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xingke was made credentialed envoy to parley before the Jin host.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詣壽寧寺朝饗祖宗神主。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: went to Shouning Temple for the morning feast before the ancestral spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the emperor went to Shouning Temple for the morning feast before the ancestral tablets.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，冬至，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，以太祖配，大赦。

translations.literal: Day renyin: winter solstice; sacrificed to August Heaven at the round altar with Taizu as companion; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, winter solstice: the emperor sacrificed to August Heaven at the round altar with Taizu as companion and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 金人陷相州，守臣趙不試死之。

translations.literal: Jin took Xiang prefecture; defender Zhao Bushi died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang fell; Zhao Bushi died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，陷德州，兵馬都監趙叔皎死之。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: took De prefecture; horse-and-army inspector Zhao Shujiao died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, De fell; Zhao Shujiao, horse-and-army inspector, died defending it.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，立士庶子弟習射補官法。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: established regulations for commoners’ sons to practice archery and gain office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, commoners’ sons were given a path to office through archery practice.

sentences.zh: 是月，節制陝西軍馬王庶為都統制曲端所拘，奪其印。

translations.literal: This month, Shaanxi controller Wang Shu was detained by commander-in-chief Qu Duan, who seized his seal.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qu Duan, commander of Shaanxi, seized Wang Shu and took his seal.

sentences.zh: 四川茶馬趙開罷官買賣茶，給引通商如政和法。

translations.literal: Sichuan tea-and-horse commissioner Zhao Kai ended official tea purchase and sale; issued passes for merchants as in the Zhenghe era.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kai of Sichuan tea-and-horse ended state tea monopoly and reopened merchant passes as under Zhenghe.

sentences.zh: 金人犯晉甯軍，守臣徐徽言拒卻之，知府州折可求以城降。

translations.literal: Jin struck Jinning army; defender Xu Huiyan held them off; Fu prefecture magistrate Zhe Keqiu surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Jinning; Xu Huiyan held; yet Zhe Keqiu of Fu surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 金人陷淄州。

translations.literal: Jin took Zi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zi fell to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 涇原兵馬都監吳玠襲斬史斌。

translations.literal: Jingyuan horse-and-army inspector Wu Jie ambushed and beheaded Shi Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie of Jingyuan ambushed and beheaded Shi Bin.

sentences.zh: 濱州賊蓋進陷棣州，守臣薑剛之死之。

translations.literal: Bin prefecture bandit Gai Jin took Di prefecture; defender Jiang Gangzhi died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Jin of Bin took Di; Jiang Gangzhi died with the city.

sentences.zh: 京東賊李民詣行在請降，王淵殲其眾，留民為將。

translations.literal: Jing-Dong bandit Li Min came to the transit court to surrender; Wang Yuan destroyed his host but kept Min as a general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Min of Jing-Dong came to court to surrender; Wang Yuan broke his band but kept Min in service.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，太后至杭州，扈從統制苗傅以其軍八千人駐奉國寺。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yimao: the empress dowager reached Hangzhou; escort controller Miao Fu encamped his eight thousand at Fengguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yimao: the empress dowager reached Hangzhou; Miao Fu and eight thousand escorts camped at Fengguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，金人犯東平府，京東西路制置使權邦彥棄城去，又犯濟南府，守臣劉豫以城降。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Jin struck Dongping; Jing-Dong-West planning commissioner Quan Bangyan abandoned the city; also struck Jinan; defender Liu Yu surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Jin struck Dongping; Quan Bangyan fled; then Jinan—Liu Yu handed over the walls.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金人陷大名府，提點刑獄郭永罵敵不屈，死之，轉運判官裴億降。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Jin took Daming; judicial intendant Guo Yong cursed the enemy and would not yield, and died; transport vice judge Pei Yi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Daming fell; Guo Yong cursed the Jin and died unbowed; Pei Yi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 又陷襲慶府。

translations.literal: Also took Xiqing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xiqing followed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，陷虢州。

translations.literal: Day yichou: took Guo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Guo fell.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，初命修國史。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: for the first time ordered compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, compilation of the national history was ordered for the first time.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以黃潛善為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎，汪伯彥右僕射兼中書侍郎，顏岐門下侍郎，朱勝非中書侍郎，兵部尚書盧益同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jisi: made Huang Qianshan Left Vice Director and Concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Wang Boyan Right Vice Director and Concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Yan Qi Vice Director of the Chancellery, Zhu Shengfei Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Minister of War Lu Yi Associate Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Huang Qianshan became Left Vice Director with Chancellery, Wang Boyan Right Vice Director with Secretariat, Yan Qi Chancellery vice director, Zhu Shengfei Secretariat vice director, and Lu Yi of War associate privy councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，金人犯青州。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Jin struck Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Jin struck Qing.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，特進致仕余深、金紫光祿大夫致仕薛昂並分司，進昌軍、徽州居住。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: specially advanced retired Yu Shen and golden-girdled grandee retired Xue Ang were both given nominal posts and sent to live in Jinchang army and Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, retired grandees Yu Shen and Xue Ang were given nominal posts and sent to Jinchang and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 耿南仲再責單州別駕，唐恪追落觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: Geng Nanzhong was again demoted to Shanzhou adjutant; Tang Ke was stripped of Observant Literary grand academician.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Nanzhong was cut again to Shanzhou adjutant; Tang Ke lost Observant Literary grand academician.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以禮部侍郎張浚兼禦營參贊軍事，教習長兵。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: made Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Jun also Imperial Camp staff officer for military affairs, to drill long weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zhang Jun of Rites was also made Imperial Camp staff officer to drill the long weapon corps.

sentences.zh: 是冬，杜充決黃河，自泗入淮，以阻金兵。

translations.literal: That winter, Du Chong breached the Yellow River so it entered the Huai from Si, to block the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Du Chong cut the Yellow River into the Huai from Si to bar the Jin.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚辰朔，帝在揚州。

translations.literal: Jianyan year 3, spring, first month, day gengchen new moon: the emperor was at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyan 3, spring, gengchen new moon: the court still sat at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以京西北路兵馬鈐轄翟興為河南尹、京西北路安撫制置兼招討使。

translations.literal: Made Huai-Northwest horse-and-army controller Zhai Xing Henan intendant, Huai-Northwest pacification and planning commissioner, and also suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Xing, Huai-Northwest horse controller, was made Henan intendant, pacification commissioner, and suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 京西賊貴仲正陷岳州。

translations.literal: Jing-West bandit Gui Zhongzheng took Yue prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Zhongzheng of Jing-West took Yue.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以資政殿學士路允迪簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: made Policy Hall academician Lu Yundi signatory of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Lu Yundi, Policy Hall academician, was made privy signatory.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金人再陷青州，又陷濰州，焚城而去。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Jin again took Qing, also took Wei, burned the cities, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Jin retook Qing and Wei, burned both, and marched away.

sentences.zh: 京東安撫劉洪道入青州守之。

translations.literal: Jing-Dong pacification commissioner Liu Hongdao entered Qing to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hongdao of Jing-Dong pacification entered Qing to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 己丑，奉安西京會聖宮累朝御容于壽寧寺。

translations.literal: Day jichou: installed the accumulated imperial portraits of Xijing Huisheng Palace dynasties at Shouning Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Xijing Huisheng Palace portraits were installed at Shouning Temple.

sentences.zh: 占城國入貢。

translations.literal: Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 趣大金通問使李鄴、周望、宋彥通、吳德休等往軍前。

translations.literal: Urged credentialed Jin inquiry envoys Li Ye, Zhou Wang, Song Yantong, and Wu Dexiu and others to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ye, Zhou Wang, Song Yantong, Wu Dexiu, and other Jin inquiry envoys were hurried to the front.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，陝州都統邵興及金人戰於潼關，敗之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Shan prefecture commander Shao Xing fought Jin at Tong Pass and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Shao Xing of Shan fought at Tong Pass and broke the Jin.

sentences.zh: 復虢州。

translations.literal: Recovered Guo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guo was recovered.

sentences.zh: 乙未，杜充遣岳飛、桑仲討其叛將張用於城南，其徒王善救之，官軍敗績。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Du Chong sent Yue Fei and Sang Zhong to suppress his mutinous general Zhang Yong south of the city; Zhang’s follower Wang Shan came to rescue; the government army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Du Chong sent Yue Fei and Sang Zhong against his mutineer Zhang Yong south of the walls; Wang Shan rescued Yong and broke the government host.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張用、王善寇淮寧府，守臣馮長寧卻之。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhang Yong and Wang Shan raided Huaining; defender Feng Changning drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Yong and Wang Shan raided Huaining; Feng Changning threw them back.

sentences.zh: 詔：「百官聞警遣家屬避兵，致物情動搖者，流。

translations.literal: An edict said, “Officials who, on hearing alarm, send families away to avoid war and thereby shake public feeling, shall be exiled.”
translations.idiomatic: An edict: hear alarm and send your household away, shaking the realm—and you are exiled.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，粘罕陷徐州，守臣王復及子倚死之，軍校趙立結鄉兵為興復計。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Nianhan took Xu prefecture; defender Wang Fu and his son Yi died; army officer Zhao Li rallied village soldiers for recovery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Nianhan took Xu; Wang Fu and his son Yi died; Zhao Li, an army officer, rallied village men to plan recovery.

sentences.zh: 禦營平寇左將軍韓世忠軍潰于沭陽，其將張遇死，世忠奔鹽城。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp left suppression general Han Shizhong’s army was routed at Shuyang; his officer Zhang Yu died; Shizhong fled to Yancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong’s left suppression army was broken at Shuyang; Zhang Yu fell; Shizhong fled to Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 金兵執淮陽守臣李寬，殺轉運副使李跋，以騎兵三千取彭城，間道趣淮甸。

translations.literal: Jin troops seized Huaiyang defender Li Kuan, killed transport deputy Li Ba, took Pengcheng with three thousand horse, and by a bypath aimed at the Huai belt.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin seized Li Kuan at Huaiyang, killed transport deputy Li Ba, took Pengcheng with three thousand horse, and turned by a hidden road toward the Huai.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至泗州。

translations.literal: Day wushen: reached Si prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, they reached Si.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌朔，始聽士民從便避兵。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu new moon: for the first time commoners were allowed to flee war as they saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengxu new moon: for the first time commoners might flee the war as they chose.

sentences.zh: 命劉正彥部兵衛皇子、六宮如杭州。

translations.literal: Ordered Liu Zhengyan to escort the imperial prince, the six palaces, and the like to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhengyan was ordered to march the imperial prince and the six palaces toward Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 江、淮制置使劉光世阻淮拒金人，敵未至，自潰。

translations.literal: Jiang-Huai planning commissioner Liu Guangshi blocked the Huai to resist Jin; before the enemy arrived, his own army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi of Jiang-Huai planning barred the Huai against the Jin—and his own host collapsed before the enemy came.

sentences.zh: 金人犯楚州，守臣朱琳降。

translations.literal: Jin struck Chu prefecture; defender Zhu Lin surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Chu; Zhu Lin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金人陷天長軍。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Jin took Tianchang army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Tianchang fell.

sentences.zh: 壬子，內侍鄺詢報金兵至，帝被甲馳幸鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day renzi: eunuch Kuang Xun reported Jin troops at hand; the emperor donned armor and galloped to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the eunuch Kuang Xun cried that the Jin were near; the emperor armored and galloped to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 是日，金兵過楊子橋。

translations.literal: That day, Jin horse crossed Yangzi Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Jin horse crossed Yangzi Bridge.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遊騎至瓜洲，太常少卿季陵奉太廟神主行，金兵追之，失太祖神主。

translations.literal: Day guichou: roaming Jin horse reached Guazhou; Court of Imperial Sacrifices vice minister Ji Ling bore the ancestral spirit tablets on the road; Jin pursued and the Taizu tablet was lost.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jin scouts reached Guazhou; Ji Ling of Imperial Sacrifices bore the ancestral tablets on the road—the Jin pursued, and Taizu’s tablet was lost.

sentences.zh: 王淵請幸杭州。

translations.literal: Wang Yuan asked that the court favor Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuan urged the court to move on Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 命留朱勝非守鎮江，以吏部尚書呂頤浩為資政殿大學士、江淮制置使，都巡檢使劉光世為殿前都指揮使，充行在五軍制置使，駐鎮江府，控扼江口。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei was left to hold Zhenjiang; Revenue Minister Lü Yihao was made Literary Hall grand academician and Huai-Jiang commissioner; metropolitan patrol commander Liu Guangshi was made Palace Front commander and commissioner over the transit court’s five armies, stationed at Zhenjiang to choke the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei stayed at Zhenjiang; Lü Yihao, revenue minister, became Literary Hall grand academician and Huai-Jiang commissioner; Liu Guangshi, metropolitan patrol commander, took Palace Front command and the five armies at Zhenjiang to hold the river mouth.

sentences.zh: 主管馬軍司楊惟忠節制江東軍馬，駐江寧府。

translations.literal: Horse-army director Yang Weizhong regulated Jiangdong forces and camped at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Weizhong, horse-army director, took Jiangdong and camped at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 是夕，發鎮江，次呂城鎮。

translations.literal: That evening they left Zhenjiang and halted at Lücheng town.
translations.idiomatic: That night they quit Zhenjiang and stopped at Lücheng.

sentences.zh: 金人入真州。

translations.literal: Jin entered Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jin raiders entered Zhen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，次常州。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: halted at Chang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the court halted at Chang.

sentences.zh: 禦營統制王亦謀據江寧，不克而遁。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp controller Wang Yi plotted to seize Jiangning, failed, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Camp controller Wang Yi tried to seize Jiangning, failed, and fled.

sentences.zh: 禦營平寇前將軍范瓊自東平引兵至壽春，其部兵殺守臣鄧紹密。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp front general Fan Qiong led troops from Dongping to Shouchun; his men killed defender Deng Shaomi.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Qiong, Imperial Camp front general, marched from Dongping to Shouchun; his troops killed defender Deng Shaomi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次平江府。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: halted at Pingjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the court reached Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，金人犯泰州，守臣曾班以城降。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Jin struck Taizhou; defender Zeng Ban surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Jin hit Taizhou; Zeng Ban handed over the walls.

sentences.zh: 丁進縱兵剽掠，王淵誘誅之。

translations.literal: Ding Jin let his men plunder; Wang Yuan lured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Jin’s men looted; Wang Yuan baited and killed him.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次吳江縣，命朱勝非節制平江府、秀州控扼軍馬，禮部侍郎張浚副之。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: halted at Wujiang county; ordered Zhu Shengfei to regulate Pingjiang and Xiuzhou forces; Rites vice minister Zhang Jun assisted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the court stopped at Wujiang; Zhu Shengfei was to hold Pingjiang and Xiuzhou; Zhang Jun of Rites assisted.

sentences.zh: 又命勝非兼禦營副使。

translations.literal: Shengfei was also made deputy Imperial Camp commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shengfei was also made deputy Imperial Camp commissioner.

sentences.zh: 留王淵守平江。

translations.literal: Wang Yuan was left to hold Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuan remained at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 以忠訓郎劉俊民為閣門祗候，齎書使金軍。

translations.literal: Loyal-training gentleman Liu Junmin was made gate usher and sent with documents to the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Junmin, loyal-training gentleman, became gate usher and carried papers to the Jin host.

sentences.zh: 詔錄用張邦昌親屬，仍命俊民持邦昌貽金人約和書稿以行。

translations.literal: An edict enrolled Zhang Bangchang’s kin; Junmin was also to carry Bangchang’s draft peace letter to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enrolled Zhang Bangchang’s kin; Junmin also bore Bangchang’s draft peace letter toward the Jin.

sentences.zh: 金人陷滄州，守臣劉錫棄城走。

translations.literal: Jin took Cang prefecture; defender Liu Xi abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Cang fell; Liu Xi abandoned the walls and fled.

sentences.zh: 己未，次秀州。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: halted at Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the court halted at Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 命呂頤浩往來經制長江，以龍圖閣待制、知江州陳彥文為沿江措置使。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao was ordered to travel the Yangzi arranging affairs; Dragon Hall awaiting-edict and Jiang prefect Chen Yanwen was made Yangzi arrangement commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao was to range the Yangzi; Chen Yanwen, Dragon Hall awaiting-edict and Jiang prefect, became Yangzi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次崇德縣。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: halted at Chongde county.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the court halted at Chongde.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩從行，即拜同簽書樞密院事、江淮兩浙制置使，以兵二千還屯京口。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao followed the court and was at once made associate military affairs commissioner and Huai and two-Zhejiang commissioner, returning with two thousand men to camp at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao, still with the court, was made associate military affairs commissioner and Huai–two-Zhejiang commissioner and sent back with two thousand men to Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 又命禦營中軍統制張俊以兵八千守吳江，吏部員外郎鄭資之為沿江防托，監察御史林之平為沿海防托，募海舟守隘。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp middle-army controller Zhang Jun was ordered with eight thousand men to hold Wujiang; Revenue Bureau junior director Zheng Zizhi was made Yangzi coastal defense commissioner; investigating censor Lin Zhiping was made seacoast defense commissioner, recruiting sea craft to guard the narrows.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun, middle-army controller, took eight thousand to Wujiang; Zheng Zizhi of Revenue ran Yangzi coastal defense; Lin Zhiping, investigating censor, ran seacoast defense and raised sea craft for the narrows.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，駐蹕杭州。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the court halted at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the court halted at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 金人陷晉寧軍，守臣徐徽言死之。

translations.literal: Jin took Jinning army; defender Xu Huiyan died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: Jinning fell; Xu Huiyan died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，下詔罪己，求直言。

translations.literal: Day guihai: an edict blamed the throne and sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the throne blamed itself and called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 令有司具舟常、潤，迎濟衣冠、軍民家屬。

translations.literal: Ordered the offices to ready boats at Chang and Run to bring north the gentry, soldiers, and families.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were told to ready boats at Chang and Run to ferry north-country gentry, troops, and families.

sentences.zh: 省儀物、膳羞，出宮人之無職掌者。

translations.literal: Cut ritual goods and palace fare; released palace women without posts.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual goods and palace fare were cut; women without posts were released.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，降德音；

translations.literal: Day yichou: issued a grace edict;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, a grace edict went out;

sentences.zh: 赦雜犯死罪以下囚，放還士大夫被竄斥者，惟李綱罪在不赦，更不放還。

translations.literal: pardoned miscellaneous capital crimes short of death, restored exiled scholar-officials, but Li Gang’s crime was not in the pardon and he was not brought back.
translations.idiomatic: miscellaneous capital crimes short of death were pardoned and banished scholar-officials restored—only Li Gang stayed beyond the pardon.

sentences.zh: 蓋用黃潛善計，罪綱以謝金人。

translations.literal: This followed Huang Qianshan’s plan, blaming Gang to appease the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Qianshan had urged it—blame Gang to appease the Jin.

sentences.zh: 置江寧府榷貨務都茶場。

translations.literal: Established the Jiangning transit monopoly tea bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangning transit monopoly tea bureau was opened.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，百官入見，應迪功郎以上並赴朝參。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the hundred officials were received in audience; all from merit gentleman of the fifth rank up attended court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, officials were received; all from fifth-rank merit gentleman up attended court.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，出米十萬斛，即杭、秀、常、湖州、平江府損直以糶，濟東北流寓之人。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: released one hundred thousand bushels of grain and ordered Hang, Xiuzhou, Chang, Huzhou, and Pingjiang to sell at reduced price to aid northeastern refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, one hundred thousand bushels were released; Hang, Xiuzhou, Chang, Hu, and Pingjiang sold cheap to feed northeastern refugees.

sentences.zh: 金人焚揚州。

translations.literal: Jin burned Yang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin burned Yang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，用御史中丞張澂言，罷黃潛善、汪伯彥，以戶部尚書葉夢得為尚書左丞，澂為右丞。

translations.literal: Day jisi: on investigating censor-in-chief Zhang Cheng’s advice, Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan were dismissed; Revenue Minister Ye Mengde was made left vice director and Cheng right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, on Zhang Cheng’s word, Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan fell; Ye Mengde of Revenue became left vice director and Cheng right vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔平江、鎮江府、常、湖、杭、越州，具寓居京朝官已上姓名以備簡拔。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: ordered Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Chang, Hu, Hang, and Yue to list metropolitan officials lodged in each circuit for selection.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Chang, Hu, Hang, and Yue were told to list lodged capital officials for selection.

sentences.zh: 分命浙西監司等官，募土豪守千秋、垂腳、襄陽諸嶺，以扼宣、常諸州險要。

translations.literal: Western Zhe circuit commissioners and others were separately ordered to recruit local stalwarts to hold Qianqiu, Chuijiao, and Xiangyang passes and choke the strategic ground of Xuan and Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe commissioners were told to recruit local stalwarts for Qianqiu, Chuijiao, and Xiangyang passes and choke Xuan and Chang.

sentences.zh: 金人去揚州。

translations.literal: Jin left Yang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin quit Yang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔禦營使司唯掌行在五軍，凡邊防經制並歸三省、樞密。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an edict said the Imperial Camp office governed only the transit court’s five armies; all frontier regulation passed to the Three Departments and Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict: the Imperial Camp office held only the five armies at court; frontier regulation returned to the Three Departments and Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 金人過高郵軍，守臣趙士瑗棄城走。

translations.literal: Jin passed Gaoyou army; defender Zhao Shiyuan abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin passed Gaoyou; Zhao Shiyuan fled.

sentences.zh: 潰兵宋進犯泰州，守臣曾班遁。

translations.literal: Routed soldiers under Song Jin struck Taizhou; defender Zeng Ban fled.
translations.idiomatic: Routed men under Song Jin hit Taizhou; Zeng Ban ran.

sentences.zh: 壬申，罷軍期司掊斂民財者。

translations.literal: Day renshen: abolished the army-term office that squeezed the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the army-term office that squeezed the people was abolished.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩遣將陳彥渡江襲金餘兵，復揚州。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao sent general Chen Yan across the river against Jin remnants and recovered Yang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao sent Chen Yan across the river against Jin remnants and retook Yang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，靳賽犯通州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Jin Sai struck Tong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Jin Sai struck Tong.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠小校李在叛據高郵。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong’s corporal Li Zai rebelled and seized Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zai, a corporal of Han Shizhong, rebelled and held Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 甲 戌，黃潛善、汪伯彥並落職。

translations.literal: Day jiashu: Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan were both stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashu, Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan lost their posts.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，召朱勝非赴行在，留張浚駐平江。

translations.literal: Day yihai: summoned Zhu Shengfei to the transit court; Zhang Jun was left at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhu Shengfei was summoned to court; Zhang Jun stayed at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 贈陳東、歐陽澈承事郎，官有服親一人，恤其家。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Chen Dong and Ouyang Che as court gentlemen; one kinsman in office for each was to comfort their households.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong and Ouyang Che were posthumously made court gentlemen; one kinsman in office was ordered to comfort each household.

sentences.zh: 召馬伸赴行在，卒，贈直龍圖閣。

translations.literal: Summoned Ma Shen to the transit court; he died on the road and was posthumously made straight Dragon Hall academician.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen was summoned to court, died on the road, and was posthumously made straight Dragon Hall academician.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔士民直言時政得失。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict called on gentry and people to speak plainly on the gains and losses of the time.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, gentry and commoners were told to speak plainly on the day’s gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 是月，以王庶為陝西節制使、知京兆府，節制司都統制曲端為鄜延經略使、知延安府。

translations.literal: This month, Wang Shu was made Shaanxi commissioner and prefect of Jingzhao; headquarters overall controller Qu Duan was made Yan-Yan pacification commissioner and prefect of Yan’an.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Shu took Shaanxi and Jingzhao; Qu Duan, headquarters overall controller, took Yan-Yan and Yan’an.

sentences.zh: 張用據確山，號「張莽蕩」。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong held Queshan and styled himself “Zhang Mangdang.”
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong held Queshan and called himself “Zhang Mangdang.”

sentences.zh: 三月己卯朔，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao new moon: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jimao new moon: a black spot appeared in the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以朱勝非為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Zhu Shengfei was made right vice director and concurrent Secretariat vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zhu Shengfei became right vice director and concurrent Secretariat vice minister.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，葉夢得罷，以盧益為尚書左丞，未拜，復罷為資政殿學士。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Ye Mengde was dismissed; Lu Yi was made left vice director but before investiture was again dismissed and made Literary Hall academician.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Ye Mengde fell; Lu Yi was named left vice director, but before taking seal was dismissed again and made Literary Hall academician.

sentences.zh: 禦營都統制王淵同簽書樞密院事，呂頤浩為江南東路安撫制置使、知江寧府。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp overall controller Wang Yuan was made associate military affairs commissioner; Lü Yihao was made Jiangdong-East soothing commissioner and Jiangning prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuan, Imperial Camp overall controller, became associate military affairs commissioner; Lü Yihao took Jiangdong-East soothing and Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔王淵免進呈書押本院文字。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict excused Wang Yuan from presenting and countersigning Privy Council documents.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wang Yuan was excused from presenting and countersigning Privy Council papers.

sentences.zh: 扈從統制苗傅忿王淵驟得君，劉正彥怨招降劇盜而賞薄。

translations.literal: Escort controller Miao Fu resented Wang Yuan’s sudden favor; Liu Zhengyan resented thin reward for recruiting great bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Fu, escort controller, hated Wang Yuan’s sudden favor; Liu Zhengyan hated thin reward for recruiting great bandits.

sentences.zh: 帝在揚州，閹宦用事恣橫，諸將多疾之。

translations.literal: When the emperor was at Yangzhou, eunuchs ran affairs at will; many generals hated them.
translations.idiomatic: At Yangzhou eunuchs ran affairs at will; many generals seethed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，傅、正彥等叛，勒兵向闕，殺王淵及內侍康履以下百餘人。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Fu, Zhengyan, and others rebelled, drove troops toward the palace, and killed Wang Yuan and over a hundred inner attendants including Kang Lü and below.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Fu and Zhengyan rebelled, marched on the palace, and killed Wang Yuan and more than a hundred inner attendants down to Kang Lü.

sentences.zh: 帝登樓，以傅為慶遠軍承宣使、禦營使司增統制，正彥渭州觀察使、副都統制。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended a tower; Fu was made Qingyuan army military commissioner and added Imperial Camp controller; Zhengyan was made Weizhou observer and deputy overall controller.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mounted a tower; Fu became Qingyuan military commissioner and added Imperial Camp controller; Zhengyan became Weizhou observer and deputy overall controller.

sentences.zh: 傅等迫帝遜位於皇子魏國公，請隆祐太后垂簾同聽政。

translations.literal: Fu and the rest forced the emperor to yield the throne to the prince, Duke of Wei; they asked Empress Dowager Longyou to rule behind the curtain with them.
translations.idiomatic: Fu forced abdication on the prince, Duke of Wei, and asked Empress Dowager Longyou to rule behind the curtain with them.

sentences.zh: 是夕，帝移禦顯寧寺。

translations.literal: That evening the emperor moved his quarters to Xianning Temple.
translations.idiomatic: That night the emperor moved to Xianning Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲申，尊帝為睿聖仁孝皇帝，以顯寧寺為睿聖宮，大赦。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the emperor was honored as Sagely, Benevolent, and Filial; Xianning Temple was made Sagely Palace; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the emperor was honored Sagely, Benevolent, and Filial; Xianning became Sagely Palace; a great amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 以張澂兼中書侍郎，韓世忠為禦營使司提舉一行事務，前軍統制張俊為秦鳳副總管，分其眾隸諸軍。

translations.literal: Zhang Cheng was made concurrent Secretariat vice minister; Han Shizhong was made Imperial Camp commissioner over the whole train; front-army controller Zhang Jun was made Qinfeng deputy overall commander and his troops were split among the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cheng took concurrent Secretariat vice minister; Han Shizhong ran the whole Imperial Camp train; Zhang Jun, front-army controller, became Qinfeng deputy overall commander and his men were split among the armies.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以東京留守杜充為資政殿大學士、節制京東西路。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Eastern Capital defender Du Chong was made Literary Hall grand academician and commissioner of Jing-Dong and Jing-Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Du Chong, Eastern Capital defender, became Literary Hall grand academician and Jing-Dong and Jing-Xi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 殿前副都指揮使、東京副留守郭仲荀進昭化軍節度使。

translations.literal: Palace Front deputy commander and Eastern Capital deputy defender Guo Zhongxun was advanced to Zhaohua army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhongxun, Palace Front deputy and Eastern Capital deputy defender, was advanced to Zhaohua military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 分竄內侍藍珪、高邈、張去為、張旦、曾擇、陳永錫于嶺南諸州。

translations.literal: Inner attendants Lan Gui, Gao Miao, Zhang Quwei, Zhang Dan, Zeng Ze, and Chen Yongxi were banished to southern ridge prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants Lan Gui, Gao Miao, Zhang Quwei, Zhang Dan, Zeng Ze, and Chen Yongxi were banished to the southern ridges.

sentences.zh: 擇已行，傅追還，殺之。

translations.literal: Ze was already on the road when Fu recalled and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ze was already on the road when Fu recalled and killed him.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩至江寧。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao reached Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao reached Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以端明殿學士王孝迪為中書侍郎、盧益為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Duanyi academician Wang Xiaodi was made Secretariat vice minister and Lu Yi left vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wang Xiaodi, Duanyi academician, became Secretariat vice minister and Lu Yi left vice director.

sentences.zh: 張俊部眾八千至平江，張浚諭以決策起兵問罪，約呂頤浩、劉光世招韓世忠來會。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun’s eight thousand reached Pingjiang; Zhang Jun urged decision to raise troops and demand accounting; he agreed with Lü Yihao and Liu Guangshi to summon Han Shizhong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun’s eight thousand reached Pingjiang; Zhang Jun of Rites urged raising troops to demand accounting; he and Lü Yihao and Liu Guangshi agreed to summon Han Shizhong.

sentences.zh: 己丑，改元明受。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the reign title was changed to Mingshou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the reign title became Mingshou.

sentences.zh: 張浚奏乞睿聖皇帝親總要務。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun memorialized begging the Sagely Emperor to resume chief affairs personally.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun memorialized begging the Sagely Emperor to resume chief affairs in person.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，百官始朝睿聖宮，以苗傅為武當軍節度使，劉正彥為武成軍節度使，劉光世為太尉、淮南制置使，范瓊為慶遠軍節度、湖北制置使，楊惟忠加少保，張浚為禮部尚書，及呂頤浩並赴行在。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the hundred officials first attended Sagely Palace; Fu was made Wudang military commissioner; Zhengyan Wucheng military commissioner; Liu Guangshi Grand Mentor and Huainan commissioner; Fan Qiong Qingyuan military commissioner and Hubei commissioner; Yang Weizhong was advanced junior guardian; Zhang Jun was made Rites minister; he and Lü Yihao were all summoned to the transit court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, officials first attended Sagely Palace; Fu became Wudang military commissioner; Zhengyan Wucheng; Liu Guangshi Grand Mentor and Huainan commissioner; Fan Qiong Qingyuan and Hubei; Yang Weizhong took junior guardian; Zhang Jun became Rites minister; he and Lü Yihao were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 傅等以禦營中軍統制吳湛主管步軍司；

translations.literal: Fu and the rest made Imperial Camp middle-army controller Wu Zhan director of the Foot Army office;
translations.idiomatic: Fu made middle-army controller Wu Zhan director of the Foot Army office;

sentences.zh: 黃潛善、汪伯彥並分司，衡、永州居住；

translations.literal: Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan were both given nominal posts and made to reside at Heng and Yong;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan took nominal posts and were settled at Heng and Yong;

sentences.zh: 王孝迪、盧益為大金國信使；

translations.literal: Wang Xiaodi and Lu Yi were made great Jin credence envoys;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaodi and Lu Yi were made great Jin credence envoys;

sentences.zh: 進士黃大本、吳時敏為先期告請使。

translations.literal: jinshi Huang Daben and Wu Shimin were made advance petition envoys.
translations.idiomatic: jinshi Huang Daben and Wu Shimin were made advance petition envoys.

sentences.zh: 置行在都茶場。

translations.literal: Established the transit court monopoly tea bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The transit court monopoly tea bureau was opened.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩奏請睿聖皇帝復大位。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao memorialized begging the Sagely Emperor to resume the great throne.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao begged the Sagely Emperor to resume the great throne.

sentences.zh: 金人陷鄜州。

translations.literal: Jin took Bin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bin fell to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，張浚命節制司參議官辛道宗措置海舶，遣布衣馮晳番持書說傅、正彥。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zhang Jun ordered regulation headquarters staff officer Xin Daozong to arrange sea vessels and sent commoner Feng Xi as envoy with letters to persuade Fu and Zhengyan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhang Jun set Xin Daozong to arrange sea craft and sent Feng Xi with letters to persuade Fu and Zhengyan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有司請尊太后為太皇太后，不許。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the offices asked to honor the empress dowager as grand empress dowager; she did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the offices asked grand empress dowager for the empress dowager; she refused.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩率勤王兵萬人發江寧。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao led ten thousand loyalist troops from Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao led ten thousand loyalist troops out of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 乙未，再貶黃潛善鎮東軍節度副使、英州安置。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Huang Qianshan was again demoted to Zhendong army deputy military commissioner and assigned to Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Huang Qianshan was again cut to Zhendong deputy military commissioner and sent to Ying.

sentences.zh: 劉光世部兵會呂頤浩於丹陽。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi’s troops joined Lü Yihao at Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi’s troops joined Lü Yihao at Danyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，韓世忠自鹽城收散卒至平江，張俊假兵二千。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Han Shizhong gathered scattered men from Yancheng to Pingjiang; Zhang Jun lent him two thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Han Shizhong gathered scattered men from Yancheng at Pingjiang; Zhang Jun lent him two thousand.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，赴行在。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: went to the transit court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, they went to the transit court.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，傅等以世忠為定國軍節度使張俊為武甯軍節度使、知鳳翔府，張浚責黃州團練副使、郴州安置。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Fu and the rest made Shizhong Dingguo military commissioner, Zhang Jun Wuning military commissioner and Fengxiang prefect, and demoted Zhang Jun of Rites to Huangzhou deputy training commissioner and assigned him to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Fu made Shizhong Dingguo military commissioner and Zhang Jun Wuning and Fengxiang; Zhang Jun of Rites was demoted to Huangzhou deputy training commissioner and sent to Chen.

sentences.zh: 俊等皆不受。

translations.literal: Jun and the rest all refused.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and the rest all refused.

sentences.zh: 傅等遣軍駐臨平，拒勤王兵。

translations.literal: Fu and the rest sent troops to camp at Linping to block the loyalist army.
translations.idiomatic: Fu sent troops to Linping to block the loyalist army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，日中黑子沒。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the sun’s black spot vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the sun’s black spot vanished.

sentences.zh: 盧益罷。

translations.literal: Lu Yi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩至平江。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao reached Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao reached Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 水賊邵青入泗州。

translations.literal: River bandit Shao Qing entered Si prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: River bandit Shao Qing entered Si.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太后詔：睿聖皇帝宜稱皇太弟、天下兵馬大元帥、康王，皇帝稱皇太侄、監國。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the empress dowager edicted: the Sagely Emperor should be called imperial younger brother, grand marshal of all armies under heaven, and Prince Kang; the emperor should be called imperial nephew and regent.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the empress dowager edicted: the Sagely Emperor was imperial younger brother, grand marshal, and Prince Kang; the emperor was imperial nephew and regent.

sentences.zh: 賜傅、正彥鐵券。

translations.literal: Fu and Zhengyan were granted iron certificates.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and Zhengyan were granted iron certificates.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩、張浚傳檄中外討傅、正彥，執黃大本下獄。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao and Zhang Jun issued proclamations throughout the realm to punish Fu and Zhengyan and imprisoned Huang Daben.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao and Zhang Jun proclaimed punishment of Fu and Zhengyan throughout the realm and jailed Huang Daben.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太后降旨睿聖皇帝處分兵馬重事。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the empress dowager issued an order for the Sagely Emperor to handle weighty military affairs.
