translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the empress dowager ordered the Sagely Emperor to handle weighty military affairs.

sentences.zh: 張俊率兵發平江，劉光世繼之。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun led troops from Pingjiang; Liu Guangshi followed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun led troops out of Pingjiang; Liu Guangshi followed.

sentences.zh: 丙午 ，張浚同知樞密院事，翰林學士李邴、御史中丞鄭鐧並同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhang Jun of Rites was made associate military affairs commissioner; Hanlin academician Li Bing and investigating censor-in-chief Zheng Duan were both made associate military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhang Jun of Rites became associate military affairs commissioner; Li Bing, Hanlin academician, and Zheng Duan, investigating censor-in-chief, took the same rank.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩、張浚發平江。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao and Zhang Jun set out from Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao and Zhang Jun marched from Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次吳江，奏乞建炎皇帝還即尊位。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: halted at Wujiang and memorialized begging the Jianyan emperor to resume the honored throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the court halted at Wujiang and begged the Jianyan emperor to resume the honored throne.

sentences.zh: 朱勝非召傅、正彥至都堂議復辟，傅等遂朝睿聖宮。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei summoned Fu and Zhengyan to the chief council hall to discuss restoration; Fu and the rest then attended Sagely Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei summoned Fu and Zhengyan to council on restoration; Fu and the rest then attended Sagely Palace.

sentences.zh: 金人陷京東諸郡，劉洪道棄青州去。

translations.literal: Jin took the eastern capital circuits; Liu Hongdao abandoned Qing and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin overran the eastern capital country; Liu Hongdao abandoned Qing and fled.

sentences.zh: 撻懶以劉豫知東平府、節制河南州郡。

translations.literal: Tadun made Liu Yu prefect of Dongping and commissioner over Henan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Tadun made Liu Yu Dongping prefect and commissioner over Henan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 趙立復徐州。

translations.literal: Zhao Li recovered Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Li recovered Xu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，太后下詔還政，皇帝復大位。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen new moon: the empress dowager edicted restoration; the emperor resumed the great throne.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wushen new moon: the empress dowager restored rule; the emperor resumed the great throne.

sentences.zh: 帝還宮，與太后御前殿垂簾，詔尊太后為隆祐皇太后。

translations.literal: The emperor returned to the palace; with the empress dowager he held court behind the curtain at the front hall; an edict honored her as Empress Dowager Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned to the palace; with the empress dowager he held court behind the curtain; she was honored Empress Dowager Longyou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔訪求太祖神主。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict sought the Taizu spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, an edict sought the Taizu spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 以苗傅為淮西制置使，劉正彥副之。

translations.literal: Miao Fu was made Huai-Xi commissioner; Liu Zhengyan was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Fu became Huai-Xi commissioner; Liu Zhengyan was his deputy.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復紀年建炎。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the reign era Jianyan was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the era name Jianyan was restored.

sentences.zh: 命張浚知樞密院事，苗傅、劉正彥並檢校少保。

translations.literal: Ordered Zhang Jun of Rites to know the Privy Council; Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan were both made checked junior guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun of Rites was ordered to know the Privy Council; Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan were both checked junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩、張浚軍次臨平，苗翊、馬柔吉拒戰不勝，傅、正彥引兵二千夜遁。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao and Zhang Jun halted at Linping; Miao Yi and Ma Rouji fought and were beaten; Fu and Zhengyan led two thousand men and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao and Zhang Jun halted at Linping; Miao Yi and Ma Rouji fought and lost; Fu and Zhengyan fled by night with two thousand.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，皇太后撤簾。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the grand empress dowager withdrew from the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the grand empress dowager withdrew from the curtain.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩等入見。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao and the rest were received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao and the rest were received in audience.

sentences.zh: 傅犯富陽、新城二縣，遣統制王德、喬仲福追擊之。

translations.literal: Fu struck Fuyang and Xincheng counties; controllers Wang De and Qiao Zhongfu were sent in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fu struck Fuyang and Xincheng; Wang De and Qiao Zhongfu were sent in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，朱勝非、顏岐、王孝迪、張澂、路允迪俱罷。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zhu Shengfei, Yan Qi, Wang Xiaodi, Zhang Cheng, and Lu Yundi were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhu Shengfei, Yan Qi, Wang Xiaodi, Zhang Cheng, and Lu Yundi all fell.

sentences.zh: 以呂頤浩為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎，李邴尚書右丞，鄭鐧簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao was made right vice director and concurrent Secretariat vice minister; Li Bing right vice director; Zheng Duan associate military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao became right vice director and concurrent Secretariat vice minister; Li Bing right vice director; Zheng Duan associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以劉光世為太尉、禦營副使，韓世忠為武勝軍節度使、御前左軍都統制，張俊為鎮西軍節度使、御前右軍都統制，勤王所僚屬將佐進官有差。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Liu Guangshi was made Grand Mentor and deputy Imperial Camp commissioner; Han Shizhong Wusheng military commissioner and overall controller of the Imperial front left army; Zhang Jun Zhenxi military commissioner and overall controller of the Imperial front right army; loyalist staff and generals were advanced in rank by degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liu Guangshi became Grand Mentor and deputy Imperial Camp commissioner; Han Shizhong Wusheng and overall of the front left army; Zhang Jun Zhenxi and overall of the front right army; loyalist officers were advanced by degrees.

sentences.zh: 主管殿前司王元、左言並責官，英、賀州安置。

translations.literal: Palace Front directors Wang Yuan and Zuo Yan were both demoted and assigned to Ying and He.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front directors Wang Yuan and Zuo Yan were demoted and sent to Ying and He.

sentences.zh: 樞密都承旨馬瑗停官、永州居住。

translations.literal: Privy Council chief usher Ma Yuan was suspended and made to reside at Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuan, Privy Council chief usher, was suspended and settled at Yong.

sentences.zh: 吏部員外郎范仲熊、浙西安撫司主管機宜文字時希孟並除名，柳州、吉陽軍編管。

translations.literal: Revenue Bureau junior director Fan Zhongxiong and western Zhe soothing headquarters staff officer Shi Ximeng were both struck from the rolls and assigned under guard to Liuzhou and Jiyang army.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongxiong of Revenue and Shi Ximeng on western Zhe soothing staff were struck from the rolls and sent under guard to Liuzhou and Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 斬中軍統制吳湛、工部侍郎王世修於市。

translations.literal: Middle-army controller Wu Zhan and Works vice minister Wang Shixiu were beheaded in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhan, middle-army controller, and Wang Shixiu of Works were beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 贈王淵開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Wang Yuan was posthumously enfeoffed Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuan was posthumously enfeoffed Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大赦。

translations.literal: Day yimao: great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 舉行仁宗法度，應嘉祐條制與今不同者，自官制役法外，賞格從重，條約從寬。

translations.literal: Renrenzong’s statutes were enacted; where Jiayou regulations differed from today, outside official system and corvée law rewards were made heavier and penalties lighter.
translations.idiomatic: Renrenzong’s statutes were enacted; where Jiayou rules differed from today, outside official system and corvée law rewards grew heavier and penalties lighter.

sentences.zh: 罷上供不急之物。

translations.literal: Tribute of non-urgent goods to the throne was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute of non-urgent goods to the throne was abolished.

sentences.zh: 元祐石刻黨人官職、恩數追復未盡者，令其家自陳。

translations.literal: Yuanyou stone-inscription factionalists whose offices and favors had not been fully restored were told to have their families report themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou stone factionalists not fully restored in office and favor were told to have their families report.

sentences.zh: 許中外直言。

translations.literal: Plain speech within and without was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Plain speech within and without was permitted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，禁內侍交通主兵官及饋遺假貸、借役禁兵、干預朝政。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: forbade inner attendants to traffic with commanders of troops or give gifts, borrow on false pretense, borrow forbidden troops, or meddle in court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, inner attendants were forbidden to traffic with troop commanders, give gifts, borrow on false pretense, borrow forbidden troops, or meddle in court affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔尚書左右僕射並帶同中書門下平章事，改門下、中書侍郎為參知政事，省尚書左、右丞。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an edict made left and right vice directors concurrently Tong Zhongshu Menxia Pingzhangshi; changed Secretariat vice ministers to participation in governance and abolished left and right vice directors of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, left and right vice directors were made concurrent Tong Zhongshu Menxia Pingzhangshi; Secretariat vice ministers became participation in governance and left and right Secretariat vice directors were abolished.

sentences.zh: 以李邴參知政事。

translations.literal: Li Bing was made participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bing was made participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 詔行在職事官各舉所知，並省館學、寺監等官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered transit-court officials each to recommend those they knew, including provincial, academic, and directorate posts.
translations.idiomatic: Transit-court officials were told each to recommend those they knew, including provincial, academic, and directorate posts.

sentences.zh: 苗傅犯衢州。

translations.literal: Miao Fu struck Qu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Fu struck Qu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以給事中周望為江、浙制置使。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Supervising Secretariat drafter Zhou Wang was made Jiang-Zhe commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhou Wang, supervising drafter, became Jiang-Zhe commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝發杭州，留鄭鐧衛皇太后，以韓世忠為江、浙制置使，及劉光世追討傅、正彥。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the emperor left Hangzhou; Zheng Duan guarded the grand empress dowager; Han Shizhong was made Jiang-Zhe commissioner; he and Liu Guangshi pursued Fu and Zhengyan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the emperor left Hangzhou; Zheng Duan guarded the grand empress dowager; Han Shizhong became Jiang-Zhe commissioner and with Liu Guangshi pursued Fu and Zhengyan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：傅、正彥、苗瑀、苗翊、張逵不赦，餘黨並原。

translations.literal: Day jisi: an edict said Fu, Zhengyan, Miao Yu, Miao Yi, and Zhang Kui were not in the pardon; the rest of the party were forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, an edict: Fu, Zhengyan, Miao Yu, Miao Yi, and Zhang Kui were beyond pardon; the rest of the party were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬申，立子魏國公旉為皇太子。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the prince, Duke of Wei Fu, was made heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the prince, Duke of Wei Fu, was made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 赦傅党王鈞甫、馬柔吉罪，許其自歸。

translations.literal: Pardoned the crimes of Fu’s partisan Wang Junfu and Ma Rouji and permitted them to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Fu’s partisans Wang Junfu and Ma Rouji were pardoned and permitted to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙子，範瓊自光、蘄引兵屯洪州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Fan Qiong led troops from Guang and Qi to camp at Hong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Fan Qiong led troops from Guang and Qi to camp at Hong.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉文舜寇濠州。

translations.literal: This month, Liu Wenshun raided Hao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Wenshun raided Hao.

sentences.zh: 西北賊薛慶襲據高郵軍。

translations.literal: Northwest bandit Xue Qing seized Gaoyou army.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest bandit Xue Qing seized Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅朔，帝次常州，以張浚為宣撫處置使，以川、陝、京西、湖南北路隸之，聽便宜黜陟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin new moon: the emperor halted at Chang; Zhang Jun of Rites was made pacification and disposition commissioner over Chuan, Shaan, Jing-Xi, and Hunan north and south, with power to demote and promote at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuyin new moon: the court halted at Chang; Zhang Jun of Rites became pacification commissioner over Chuan, Shaan, Jing-Xi, and Hunan north and south with discretionary demotion and promotion.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，苗傅統領官張翼斬王鈞甫、馬柔吉降。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Fu’s overall officer Zhang Yi beheaded Wang Junfu and Ma Rouji and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zhang Yi, Fu’s overall officer, beheaded Wang Junfu and Ma Rouji and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，次鎮江府，遣祭張愨、陳東墓，詔恤其家。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: halted at Zhenjiang; sent envoys to sacrifice at the tombs of Zhang Ce and Chen Dong; an edict comforted their households.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the court halted at Zhenjiang, sacrificed at Zhang Ce’s and Chen Dong’s tombs, and comforted their households.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以翰林學士滕康同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Hanlin academician Teng Kang was made associate military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Teng Kang, Hanlin academician, became associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，至江寧府，駐蹕神霄宮，改府名建康。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: reached Jiangning prefecture, halted at Shenxiao Palace, and changed the prefecture name to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the court reached Jiangning, halted at Shenxiao Palace, and renamed the prefecture Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 起復朝散郎洪皓為大金通問使。

translations.literal: Restored Hong Hao, court gentleman of the fourth rank, as great Jin inquiry envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Hao, court gentleman of the fourth rank, was restored as great Jin inquiry envoy.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以徽猷閣直學士陳彥文提領水軍，措置江、浙防托。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Huixian Pavilion straight academician Chen Yanwen was placed in charge of the navy and arranged Jiang-Zhe coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Chen Yanwen, Huixian straight academician, took the navy and arranged Jiang-Zhe coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 召藍珪等速還朝。

translations.literal: Summoned Lan Gui and the rest to return swiftly to court.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Gui and the rest were summoned to return swiftly to court.

sentences.zh: 己丑，韓世忠追討傅、正彥於浦城縣，獲正彥，傅遁走。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Han Shizhong pursued Fu and Zhengyan at Pucheng county, captured Zhengyan, and Fu fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Han Shizhong pursued Fu and Zhengyan at Pucheng, took Zhengyan, and Fu fled.

sentences.zh: 張浚撫諭薛慶于高郵，為慶所留。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun of Rites soothed Xue Qing at Gaoyou and was detained by Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun of Rites soothed Xue Qing at Gaoyou and was held by Qing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，浚罷。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Jun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以禦營前軍統制王曁燮為淮南招撫使。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp front-army controller Wang Xie was made Huainan recruitment commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xie, front-army controller, became Huainan recruitment commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，復置中書門下省檢正官，省左、右司郎中二員。

translations.literal: Day jihai: restored Secretariat and Chancellery examination officers and abolished two left and right secretariat bureau directors.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Secretariat and Chancellery examination officers were restored and two left and right secretariat bureau directors were abolished.

sentences.zh: 苗傅裨將江池殺苗翊，降于周望。

translations.literal: Fu’s lieutenant Jiang Chi killed Miao Yi and surrendered to Zhou Wang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Chi, Fu’s lieutenant, killed Miao Yi and surrendered to Zhou Wang.

sentences.zh: 傅走建陽縣，土豪詹標執之以獻。

translations.literal: Fu fled to Jianyang county; local stalwart Zhan Biao seized him and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu fled to Jianyang; Zhan Biao, a local stalwart, seized him and presented him.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，張浚還自高郵。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Zhang Jun of Rites returned from Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhang Jun of Rites returned from Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 復命知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to know the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered to know the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 是月，翟興擊殺楊進餘黨，復推其徒劉可拒官軍。

translations.literal: This month, Zhai Xing struck and killed Yang Jin’s remnant party, then again set up his follower Liu Ke to resist the government army.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhai Xing killed Yang Jin’s remnant band, then set up Liu Ke to resist the government army.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申朔，以東京留守杜充引兵赴行在，命兼宣撫處置副使，節制淮南、京東西路。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen new moon: Eastern Capital defender Du Chong led troops to the transit court and was ordered concurrent pacification deputy and commissioner of Huainan and Jing-Dong and Jing-Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wushen new moon: Du Chong, Eastern Capital defender, led troops to court and was made concurrent pacification deputy and Huainan and Jing-Dong and Jing-Xi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以久雨，召郎官已上言闕政，呂頤浩請令實封以聞。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: because of long rain, summoned court gentlemen and above to speak on neglected government; Lü Yihao asked that submissions be sealed and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, after long rain, court gentlemen and above were summoned on neglected government; Lü Yihao asked sealed submissions.

sentences.zh: 遂用司勳員外郎趙鼎言，罷王安石配享神宗廟庭，以司馬光配。

translations.literal: They then followed Merit Bureau junior director Zhao Ding: removed Wang Anshi from Shenzong’s temple side-hall and installed Sima Guang.
translations.idiomatic: They then followed Zhao Ding of Merit Bureau: Wang Anshi was removed from Shenzong’s temple side-hall and Sima Guang installed.

sentences.zh: 王善攻淮寧府不克，轉寇宿州，統領王冠戰敗之。

translations.literal: Wang Shan attacked Huaining prefecture without success, turned to raid Xu, and overall officer Wang Guan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shan failed at Huaining, turned to raid Xu, and Wang Guan, his overall officer, defeated him.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷賞功司。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: abolished the reward-merit office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the reward-merit office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命恤死事者家，且錄其後。

translations.literal: Day yimao: ordered comfort for households of those who died in service and enrollment of their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, households of the dead in service were to be comforted and descendants enrolled.

sentences.zh: 升浙西安撫使康允之為制置使。

translations.literal: Western Zhe soothing commissioner Kang Yunzhi was advanced to commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Yunzhi, western Zhe soothing commissioner, was advanced to full commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，劉光世招安苗傅將韓雋。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Liu Guangshi induced Fu’s general Han Juan to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Liu Guangshi induced Fu’s general Han Juan to surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命江、浙、淮南引塘濼、開畎澮，以阻金兵。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: ordered Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan to draw on ponds and marshes and open irrigation ditches to block Jin troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan were told to flood ponds and marshes and open ditches to block Jin troops.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇太后至建康府。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the grand empress dowager reached Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the grand empress dowager reached Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以久陰，下詔以四失罪己：一曰昧經邦之大略，二曰昧戡難之遠圖，三曰無綏人之德，四曰失馭臣之柄。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: because of long overcast skies, an edict blamed the throne for four failures: first, ignorance of the great plan to govern the state; second, ignorance of the far design to quell calamity; third, lack of virtue to soothe the people; fourth, loss of the handle to control ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, under long overcast skies, an edict blamed the throne for four failures: ignorance of governing the state, ignorance of far design to quell calamity, lack of virtue to soothe the people, and loss of the handle on ministers.

sentences.zh: 仍榜朝堂，遍諭天下，使知朕悔過之意。

translations.literal: It was also posted at the court hall and proclaimed throughout the realm so all would know the throne’s repentance.
translations.idiomatic: It was posted at court and proclaimed throughout the realm so all would know the throne’s repentance.

sentences.zh: 以帶禦器械李質權同主管殿前司。

translations.literal: Bearer of the imperial armory Li Zhi was made acting co-director of the Palace Front office.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhi, bearer of the imperial armory, was made acting co-director of Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以建康府路安撫使連南夫兼建康府、宣、徽、太平等州制置使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Jiankang circuit soothing commissioner Lian Nanfu was made concurrent Jiankang prefect and commissioner of Xuan, Hui, and Taiping prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Lian Nanfu, Jiankang soothing commissioner, took concurrent Jiankang and commissioner over Xuan, Hui, and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，右司諫袁植請誅黃潛善及失守者權邦彥等九人。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Right Secretariat remonstrance officer Yuan Zhi asked execution of Huang Qianshan and the nine who lost their posts, including Qu Bangyan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Yuan Zhi of Right Secretariat remonstrance asked execution of Huang Qianshan and nine who had lost their posts, including Qu Bangyan.

sentences.zh: 詔：「朕方念咎責己，豈可盡以過失歸於臣下？

translations.literal: An edict said, “The throne is now blaming itself—how can all fault be laid on ministers below?”
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, “The throne is blaming itself—how can all fault fall on ministers below?”

sentences.zh: 」遂罷植知池州，以趙鼎為右司諫。

translations.literal: Zhi was then dismissed as Chi prefect and Zhao Ding was made Right Secretariat remonstrance officer.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi was dismissed to Chi; Zhao Ding became Right Secretariat remonstrance officer.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，置樞密院檢詳官。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: established Privy Council examination officers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Privy Council examination officers were established.

sentences.zh: 以右司郎中劉甯止為沿江措置副使。

translations.literal: Right secretariat bureau director Liu Ningzhi was made Yangzi arrangement deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ningzhi, right secretariat bureau director, became Yangzi arrangement deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，移禦行宮。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: moved quarters to the transit palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, quarters moved to the transit palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔諭中外：「以迫近防秋，請太后率宗室迎奉神主如江表，百司庶府非軍旅之事者，並令從行。

translations.literal: Day yihai: an edict told the realm: “With autumn defense near, the empress dowager is to lead the imperial clan to welcome the spirit tablets south of the Yangzi; all offices not concerned with military affairs are to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, an edict told the realm: “With autumn defense near, the empress dowager is to lead the clan to welcome the spirit tablets south of the Yangzi; all non-military offices are to follow.

sentences.zh: 朕與輔臣宿將備禦寇敵，應接中原。

translations.literal: The emperor and chief ministers and veteran generals will guard against the foe and answer the central plains.”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, chief ministers, and veteran generals will guard the foe and answer the central plains.”

sentences.zh: 官吏民士家屬南去者，有司毋禁。

translations.literal: Officials, soldiers, and common households moving south were not to be forbidden by the offices.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, soldiers, and households moving south were not to be stopped.

sentences.zh: 」金人陷磁州。

translations.literal: Jin took Ci prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ci fell to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 是夏，賊貴仲正降。

translations.literal: That summer, bandit Gui Zhongzheng surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That summer bandit Gui Zhongzheng surrendered.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，贈王復為資政殿學士。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: Wang Fu was posthumously made Literary Hall academician.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuyin: Wang Fu was posthumously made Literary Hall academician.

sentences.zh: 己卯，親慮囚。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the emperor personally judged prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the emperor personally judged prisoners.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，苗傅、劉正彥伏誅。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，進韓世忠檢校少保、武勝昭慶軍節度使、禦營使司都統制。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Han Shizhong was advanced checked junior guardian, Wusheng-Zhaoqing military commissioner, and Imperial Camp overall controller.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Han Shizhong was advanced checked junior guardian, Wusheng-Zhaoqing military commissioner, and Imperial Camp overall controller.

sentences.zh: 范瓊自洪州入朝，以瓊為禦營使司提舉一行事務，後軍統制辛企宗為都統制。

translations.literal: Fan Qiong came to court from Hong; Qiong was made Imperial Camp commissioner over the whole train; rear-army controller Xin Qizong was made overall controller.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Qiong came from Hong to court; he was made Imperial Camp commissioner over the whole train; Xin Qizong, rear-army controller, became overall controller.

sentences.zh: 命學士院草夏國書、大金國表本付張浚。

translations.literal: Ordered the Hanlin Academy to draft Western Xia letters and great Jin memorial forms and deliver them to Zhang Jun of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy was ordered to draft Western Xia letters and great Jin memorial forms for Zhang Jun of Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔以苗、劉之變，當軸大臣不能身衛社稷，朱勝非、顏岐、路允迪並落職，張澂衡州居住。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: an edict said that in the Miao–Liu mutiny the chief ministers had not guarded the altars in person; Zhu Shengfei, Yan Qi, and Lu Yundi were all stripped of office; Zhang Cheng was made to reside at Heng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, an edict: in the Miao–Liu mutiny chief ministers had not guarded the altars; Zhu Shengfei, Yan Qi, and Lu Yundi fell; Zhang Cheng was settled at Heng.

sentences.zh: 以知廬州胡舜陟為淮西制置使，知江州權邦彥兼本路制置使。

translations.literal: Lu prefect Hu Shunzhi was made Huai-Xi commissioner; Jiang prefect Qu Bangyan was made concurrent circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shunzhi of Lu became Huai-Xi commissioner; Qu Bangyan of Jiang took concurrent circuit commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人犯山東，安撫使劉洪道棄濰州遁，萊州守將張成舉城降。

translations.literal: Jin struck Shandong; soothing commissioner Liu Hongdao abandoned Wei and fled; Laizhou defender Zhang Cheng surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Shandong; Liu Hongdao abandoned Wei and fled; Zhang Cheng of Laizhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以範瓊跋扈無狀，收下大理獄，分其兵隸神武五軍。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because Fan Qiong was overbearing and lawless, he was taken into the Court of Judicial Review and his troops were split among the five Divine Martial armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Fan Qiong, overbearing and lawless, was taken into judicial review and his troops split among the five Divine Martial armies.

sentences.zh: 皇太子薨，諡元懿。

translations.literal: The heir apparent died; posthumous title Yuanyi.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent died; posthumous title Yuanyi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，鄭鐧薨。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zheng Duan died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zheng Duan died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以資政殿大學士王綯參知政事，兵部尚書周望同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Literary Hall grand academician Wang Chao was made participation in governance; War Minister Zhou Wang associate military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wang Chao, Literary Hall grand academician, became participation in governance; Zhou Wang, war minister, associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，仙井監鄉貢進士李時雨上書，乞選立宗子系屬人心，帝怒，斥還鄉里。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Xianjing Supervisor presented-degree scholar Li Shiyu memorialized, begging to select and establish an imperial clansman of a lineage the people could trust; the emperor was enraged and sent him back to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, presented-degree scholar Li Shiyu of Xianjing Supervisor memorialized to select an imperial clansman the people could trust; the emperor was enraged and sent him home.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，升杭州為臨安府。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Hangzhou was promoted to Lin'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Hangzhou was promoted to Lin'an prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，言者又論範瓊逼遷徽宗及迎立張邦昌，瓊辭伏，賜死，子弟皆流嶺南。

translations.literal: Day renchen: critics again charged Fan Qiong with forcing the relocation of Huizong and with welcoming Zhang Bangchang to the throne; Qiong confessed; he was granted death; sons and younger brothers were all exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Fan Qiong was again charged with forcing Huizong’s move and welcoming Zhang Bangchang; he confessed, was put to death, and his sons and brothers were exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 劉洪道復青州，執金守向大猷。

translations.literal: Liu Hongdao recovered Qing prefecture and seized the Jin defender Xiang Dayou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hongdao recovered Qing and seized Jin defender Xiang Dayou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣謝亮使夏國。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Xie Liang was sent as envoy to the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Xie Liang was sent as envoy to Xia.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣崔縱使金軍前。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Cui Zong was sent as envoy to the Jin forward army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Cui Zong was sent as envoy to the Jin forward army.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張浚發行在。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhang Jun set out from the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Jun set out from the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，王曁燮與靳賽遇，合戰，敗績。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Wang Yanxie met Jin Sai in battle; they fought; his army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Wang Yanxie met Jin Sai in battle and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命李邴、滕康權知三省、樞密院事，扈從太后如洪州，楊惟忠將兵萬人以衛。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Li Bing and Teng Kang were ordered to act as heads of the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission and escort the empress dowager to Hong prefecture; Yang Weizhong led ten thousand troops as guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Li Bing and Teng Kang were ordered to head the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission and escort the empress dowager to Hong; Yang Weizhong led ten thousand troops as guard.

sentences.zh: 以杜充同知樞密院事兼宣撫處置副使。

translations.literal: Du Chong was made associate military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chong was made associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔江西、閩、廣、荊湖諸路團教峒丁、槍杖手。

translations.literal: Day yisi: an edict ordered Jiangxi, Min, Guang, and Jing-Hu circuits to drill cave militia and pike troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Jiangxi, Min, Guang, and Jing-Hu were ordered to drill cave militia and pike troops.

sentences.zh: 山東賊郭仲威陷淮陽軍。

translations.literal: Shandong bandit Guo Zhongwei took Huaiyang army.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong bandit Guo Zhongwei took Huaiyang army.

sentences.zh: 翟興引兵入汝州，與賊王俊戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Zhai Xing led troops into Ru prefecture, fought bandit Wang Jun, and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Xing entered Ru, fought bandit Wang Jun, and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，移浙西安撫司於鎮江府。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: the western Zhe pacification office was moved to Zhenjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou: the western Zhe pacification office moved to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，李邴罷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Li Bing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Li Bing was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以吏部尚書劉玨為端明殿學士、權同知三省、樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Personnel Minister Liu Jue was made Bright Hall academician and acting co-head of the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Personnel Minister Liu Jue became Bright Hall academician and acting co-head of the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，王庶罷。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wang Shu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wang Shu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以徽猷閣直學士、知慶陽府王似為陝西節制使。

translations.literal: Emblematic Writings Hall academician and Qingyang prefect Wang Si was made Shaanxi commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Emblematic Writings Hall academician and Qingyang prefect Wang Si was made Shaanxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 劉文舜入舒州。

translations.literal: Liu Wenshun entered Shu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wenshun entered Shu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，太后發建康。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the empress dowager set out from Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the empress dowager left Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣杜時亮使金軍前。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Du Shiliang was sent as envoy to the Jin forward army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Du Shiliang was sent as envoy to the Jin forward army.

sentences.zh: 閏八月丁丑朔，以胡舜陟為沿江都制置使，集英殿修撰王羲叔副之。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day dingchou new moon: Hu Shunsheng was made Yangtze-line overall commissioner; Hall for Assembling Elegance compiler Wang Xishu was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary eighth month, dingchou new moon: Hu Shunsheng became Yangtze-line overall commissioner; compiler Wang Xishu was his deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，輔逵掠漣水軍，殺軍使郝璘，率眾降于王曁燮。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Fu Kui plundered Lianshui army, killed army commissioner Hao Lin, and led his followers to surrender to Wang Yanxie.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Fu Kui plundered Lianshui army, killed commissioner Hao Lin, and surrendered to Wang Yanxie.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以呂頤浩守尚書左僕射，杜充守右僕射，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Lü Yihao was made left vice director and Du Chong right vice director, both co-equal chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Lü Yihao became left vice director and Du Chong right vice director, both co-equal chancellors.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，起居郎胡寅上書言二十事，呂頤浩不悅，罷之。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Attendant Gentleman Hu Yin memorialized on twenty matters; Lü Yihao was displeased and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Attendant Gentleman Hu Yin memorialized on twenty matters; Lü Yihao dismissed him in displeasure.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命杜充兼江、淮宣撫使、守建康，前軍統制王曁燮隸之，韓世忠為漸西置使守鎮江，劉光世為江東宣撫使守太平、池州，並受充節制。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Du Chong was ordered also to be Jiang-Huai pacification commissioner and hold Jiankang; forward-army commander Wang Yanxie was placed under him; Han Shizhong was made Jiang-Huai-West commissioner and held Zhenjiang; Liu Guangshi was made Jiangdong pacification commissioner and held Taiping and Chizhou; all were under Chong’s command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Du Chong was also made Jiang-Huai pacification commissioner at Jiankang with Wang Yanxie under him; Han Shizhong became Jiang-Huai-West commissioner at Zhenjiang; Liu Guangshi became Jiangdong pacification commissioner at Taiping and Chizhou; all were under Chong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太后至洪州。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the empress dowager reached Hong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the empress dowager reached Hong.

sentences.zh: 己亥，減福建、廣南歲上供銀三之一。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Fujian and Guangnan annual tribute silver was reduced by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Fujian and Guangnan annual tribute silver was cut by one-third.

sentences.zh: 詔制置使唯用兵聽便宜，餘事悉禁。

translations.literal: An edict: commissioners might use troops at discretion; all other matters were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed commissioners to use troops at discretion; all else was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，帝發建康，復還浙西，張俊、辛企宗以其軍從。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the emperor left Jiankang, returned again to western Zhe; Zhang Jun and Xin Qizong followed with their armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the emperor left Jiankang for western Zhe again; Zhang Jun and Xin Qizong followed with their armies.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，次鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the court halted at Zhenjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the court halted at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 賜陳東家金。

translations.literal: Chen Dong’s family was given gold.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong’s family was given gold.

sentences.zh: 張浚次襄陽，招官軍、義兵分屯襄、郢、唐、鄧，以程千秋、李允文節制。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun halted at Xiangyang, recruited government and loyalist troops, and stationed them at Xiang, Ying, Tang, and Deng under Cheng Qianqiu and Li Yunwen as commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun halted at Xiangyang, recruited government and loyalist troops, and posted them at Xiang, Ying, Tang, and Deng under Cheng Qianqiu and Li Yunwen.

sentences.zh: 是月，知濟南府宮儀及金人數戰於密州，兵潰，儀及劉洪道俱奔淮南，守將李逵以密州降金。

translations.literal: That month Jinan prefect Gong Yi fought the Jin several times at Mi prefecture; the army broke; Yi and Liu Hongdao both fled to Huainan; defender Li Kui surrendered Mi to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jinan prefect Gong Yi fought the Jin repeatedly at Mi; the army broke; Yi and Liu Hongdao fled to Huainan; defender Li Kui surrendered Mi.

sentences.zh: 靳賽詣劉光世降。

translations.literal: Jin Sai came to Liu Guangshi and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Sai came to Liu Guangshi and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingwu new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 諜報金人治舟師，將由海道窺江、浙，遣韓世忠控守圌山、福山。

translations.literal: Spies reported the Jin were fitting out a fleet and would probe Jiang and Zhe by sea; Han Shizhong was sent to hold Tuanshan and Fushan.
translations.idiomatic: Spies reported the Jin fitting a fleet to probe Jiang and Zhe by sea; Han Shizhong was sent to hold Tuanshan and Fushan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，次平江府。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the court halted at Pingjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the court halted at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，金人陷單州、興仁府，遂陷南京，執守臣淩唐佐，降之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Jin took Dan prefecture and Xingren prefecture, then took Nanjing and seized defender Ling Tangzuo, who surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Jin took Dan and Xingren, then Nanjing; defender Ling Tangzuo was seized and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以周望為兩浙、荊湖等路宣撫使，總兵守平江。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhou Wang was made pacification commissioner of the two Zhe, Jing-Hu, and related circuits and commanded troops to hold Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhou Wang was made pacification commissioner of two Zhe, Jing-Hu, and related circuits to hold Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士張守同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Zhang Shou was made co-signatory of the Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Zhang Shou became co-signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 命劉光世移屯江州。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi was ordered to move his encampment to Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi was ordered to move camp to Jiang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣張邵等充金國軍前通問使。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Zhang Shao and others were sent as envoys to inquire of the Jin forward army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhang Shao and others were sent as envoys to the Jin forward army.

sentences.zh: 金人陷沂州。

translations.literal: The Jin took Yi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Yi.

sentences.zh: 卻高麗入貢使。

translations.literal: The Goryeo tribute mission was turned back.
translations.idiomatic: The Goryeo tribute mission was turned back.

sentences.zh: 張浚承制罷知潭州辛炳，起復直龍圖閣向子諲代之。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun by imperial order dismissed Tan prefect Xin Bing and restored Dragon Diagram Hall academician Xiang Ziyun to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun by imperial order dismissed Tan prefect Xin Bing and restored Dragon Diagram academician Xiang Ziyun in his place.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，蠲諸路青苗積欠錢。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: green-sprout arrears on every circuit were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, green-sprout arrears on every circuit were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，知鼎州邢倞坐結耶律餘睹，再責汝州團練副使、英州安置。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: acting Ding prefect Xing Zun was charged with linking to Yelü Yudu; he was again demoted to Yingzhou regiment vice commander and settled at Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, acting Ding prefect Xing Zun was charged with linking to Yelü Yudu, demoted to Yingzhou regiment vice commander, and settled at Ying.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜宿、泗州都大提舉使李成軍絹二萬匹，成尋復叛。

translations.literal: Day guihai: twenty thousand bolts of silk were granted to Li Cheng’s army as overall commissioner of Su and Si; Cheng soon rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, twenty thousand bolts of silk were granted Li Cheng’s army at Su and Si; Cheng soon rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以胡舜陟為兩浙宣撫司參謀官，知鎮江府陳邦光為沿江都制置使。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Hu Shunsheng was made staff officer of the two-Zhe pacification office; Zhenjiang prefect Chen Bangguang was made Yangtze-line overall commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Hu Shunsheng became staff officer of the two-Zhe pacification office; Zhenjiang prefect Chen Bangguang became Yangtze-line overall commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以工部侍郎湯東野知平江府兼浙西制置使。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Works Vice Minister Tang Dongye was made Pingjiang prefect and western Zhe commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Works Vice Minister Tang Dongye became Pingjiang prefect and western Zhe commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，追復鄒浩龍圖閣待制。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Zou Hao was posthumously restored as Dragon Diagram Hall awaiting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zou Hao was posthumously restored as Dragon Diagram awaiting appointment.

sentences.zh: 壬申夜，潭州禁卒作亂，謀竄不果，向子諲隨招安之。

translations.literal: Night of day renshen: Tan prefecture garrison troops mutinied; a plot to flee failed; Xiang Ziyun soon pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Night of renshen: Tan garrison troops mutinied; a flight plot failed and Xiang Ziyun soon pacified them.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，金帥婁宿犯長安，經略使郭琰棄城遁，河北賊酈瓊圍光州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Jin commander Lou Shi attacked Chang'an; commissioner Guo Yan abandoned the city and fled; Hebei bandit Li Qiong besieged Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Jin commander Lou Shi attacked Chang'an; commissioner Guo Yan fled; Hebei bandit Li Qiong besieged Guang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，詔按察官歲上所發擿贓吏姓名以為殿最。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingzi new moon: an edict ordered inspection officials each year to report exposed corrupt officials by name for merit ranking.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingzi new moon: inspection officials were ordered yearly to report corrupt officials by name for merit ranking.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禁諸軍擅入川、陝。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: armies were forbidden to enter Shu and Shaanxi without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, armies were forbidden to enter Shu and Shaanxi without authorization.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝至杭州，復如浙東。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the emperor reached Hangzhou and went again to eastern Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the emperor reached Hangzhou and went again to eastern Zhe.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，渡浙江。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: he crossed the Zhe River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he crossed the Zhe River.

sentences.zh: 郭仲威詣周望降，望以仲威為本司統制。

translations.literal: Guo Zhongwei came to Zhou Wang and surrendered; Wang made Zhongwei a commander of his headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhongwei surrendered to Zhou Wang, who made him a headquarters commander.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李成陷滁州，殺守臣向子伋。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Cheng took Chu prefecture and killed defender Xiang Zijin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Cheng took Chu and killed defender Xiang Zijin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，帝至越州。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the emperor reached Yue prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the emperor reached Yue.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命提舉廣西峒丁李棫市馬，邕州置牧養務。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Li Yi was ordered to purchase horses from Guangxi cave militia; a breeding office was set up at Yong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Yi was ordered to buy horses from Guangxi cave militia; a breeding office was set up at Yong.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，初命東南八路歲收經制五項錢輸行在。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: for the first time the southeast eight circuits were ordered yearly to send the five regulated-funds items to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the southeast eight circuits were first ordered yearly to send the five regulated funds to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 張浚治兵於興元府。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun drilled troops at Xingyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun drilled troops at Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 金人陷壽春府。

translations.literal: The Jin took Shouchun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 庚子，陷黃州，守臣趙令峸死之。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: they took Huang prefecture; defender Zhao Ling'e died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, they took Huang; defender Zhao Ling'e died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，張浚以同主管川、陝茶馬趙開為隨軍轉運使，專總四川財賦。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Zhang Jun made co-director of Sichuan-Shaanxi tea and horses Zhao Kai follow-the-army transport commissioner with sole charge of Sichuan revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhang Jun made Zhao Kai follow-the-army transport commissioner with sole charge of Sichuan revenue.

sentences.zh: 金人自黃州濟江，劉光世引軍遁，知江州韓梠棄城去。

translations.literal: The Jin crossed the river from Huang; Liu Guangshi led his army in flight; Jiang prefect Han Mou abandoned the city and left.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin crossed from Huang; Liu Guangshi fled; Jiang prefect Han Mou abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 金人自大冶縣趨洪州。

translations.literal: The Jin marched from Daye county toward Hong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin marched from Daye toward Hong.

sentences.zh: 是月，京西賊劉滿陷信陽軍，殺守臣趙士負。

translations.literal: That month Jingxi bandit Liu Man took Xinyang army and killed defender Zhao Shifu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jingxi bandit Liu Man took Xinyang army and killed defender Zhao Shifu.

sentences.zh: 盜入宿州，殺通判盛修已。

translations.literal: Bandits entered Su prefecture and killed vice prefect Sheng Xiuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits entered Su and killed vice prefect Sheng Xiuyi.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳朔，金人犯廬州，守臣李會以城降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi new moon: the Jin attacked Lu prefecture; defender Li Hui surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yisi new moon: the Jin attacked Lu; defender Li Hui surrendered.

sentences.zh: 王善叛降金，金人執之。

translations.literal: Wang Shan rebelled and surrendered to the Jin; the Jin seized him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shan rebelled and surrendered to the Jin, who seized him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔降雜犯死罪，釋流以下囚，聽李綱自便，追復宋齊愈官。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict reduced capital punishment for miscellaneous crimes, released prisoners below exile, allowed Li Gang to act at will, and posthumously restored Song Qiyu’s office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, capital punishment for miscellaneous crimes was reduced, prisoners below exile were released, Li Gang was left at liberty, and Song Qiyu’s office was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 貴仲正犯荊南，兵馬鈐轄渠成與戰，斬之。

translations.literal: Gui Zhongzheng attacked Jingnan; military commissioner Qu Cheng fought him and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Zhongzheng attacked Jingnan; military commissioner Qu Cheng fought and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，金帥兀犯和州，守臣李儔以城降，通判唐璟死之。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Jin commander Wusu attacked He prefecture; defender Li Chou surrendered the city; vice prefect Tang Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Jin commander Wusu attacked He; defender Li Chou surrendered; vice prefect Tang Jing died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張浚出行關、陝。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Zhang Jun set out for the passes of Guan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhang Jun set out for Guan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 兀陷無為軍，守臣李知幾棄城走。

translations.literal: Wusu took Wuwei army; defender Li Zhiji abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wusu took Wuwei; defender Li Zhiji fled.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太后退保虔州。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the empress dowager withdrew to secure Gan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the empress dowager withdrew to Gan.

sentences.zh: 江西制置使王子獻棄洪州走。

translations.literal: Jiangxi commissioner Wang Zixian abandoned Hong and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi commissioner Wang Zixian abandoned Hong and fled.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，金人陷臨江軍，守臣吳將之遁。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the Jin took Linjiang army; defender Wu Jiangzhi fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Jin took Linjiang; defender Wu Jiangzhi fled.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣孫悟等充金國軍前致書使。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Sun Wu and others were sent as envoys bearing letters to the Jin forward army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Sun Wu and others were sent as letter-bearing envoys to the Jin forward army.

sentences.zh: 金人陷洪州，權知州李積中以城降。

translations.literal: The Jin took Hong; acting prefect Li Jizhong surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Hong; acting prefect Li Jizhong surrendered.

sentences.zh: 撫、袁二州守臣王仲山、王仲嶷皆降。

translations.literal: Defenders of Fu and Yuan, Wang Zhongshan and Wang Zhongyi, both surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and Yuan defenders Wang Zhongshan and Wang Zhongyi both surrendered.

sentences.zh: 淮賊劉忠犯蘄州，韓世清逆戰，破之。

translations.literal: Huai bandit Liu Zhong attacked Qi prefecture; Han Shiqing met him in battle and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Huai bandit Liu Zhong attacked Qi; Han Shiqing met him and broke his force.

sentences.zh: 忠入舒州，殺通判孫知微。

translations.literal: Zhong entered Shu prefecture and killed vice prefect Sun Zhiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong entered Shu and killed vice prefect Sun Zhiwei.

sentences.zh: 庚申，金人陷真州，守臣向子忞棄城去。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the Jin took Zhen prefecture; defender Xiang Zimin abandoned the city and left.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Jin took Zhen; defender Xiang Zimin fled.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太后至吉州。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the empress dowager reached Ji prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the empress dowager reached Ji.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，金人犯建康府，陷溧水，縣尉潘振死之。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the Jin attacked Jiankang; they took Lishui; county aide Pan Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Jin attacked Jiankang, took Lishui, and county aide Pan Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，金人陷太平州。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Jin took Taiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Jin took Taiping.

sentences.zh: 主管步軍司閭勍自西京奉累朝御容至行在，詔奉安于天慶觀，尋命勍節制淮西軍馬，以拒金人。

translations.literal: Director of the Foot Army Office Yan Qing brought successive-dynasty imperial portraits from the western capital to the mobile court; an edict ordered them installed at Tianqing Abbey; soon Qing was ordered to command Huai-west troops to resist the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Foot Army director Yan Qing brought successive imperial portraits from the western capital to the mobile court; they were installed at Tianqing Abbey; soon Qing was ordered to command Huai-west troops against the Jin.

sentences.zh: 甲子，杜充遣都統制陳淬、岳飛等及金人戰于馬家渡，王曁燮以軍先遁，淬敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Du Chong sent headquarters commander Chen Cui, Yue Fei, and others to fight the Jin at Ma Family Ford; Wang Yanxie’s army fled first; Cui was defeated and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Du Chong sent Chen Cui, Yue Fei, and others against the Jin at Ma Family Ford; Wang Yanxie fled first; Cui was defeated and died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以檢正諸房公事傅崧卿為浙東防遏使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Reviewing Official of the Various Bureaus Fu Songqing was made eastern Zhe defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Reviewing Official Fu Songqing became eastern Zhe defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太后發吉州，次太和縣。

translations.literal: The empress dowager left Ji and halted at Taihe county.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager left Ji and halted at Taihe.

sentences.zh: 護衛統制杜彥及後軍楊世雄率眾叛，犯永豐縣，知縣事趙訓之死之。

translations.literal: Guard commander Du Yan and rear-army Yang Shixiong led troops in rebellion, attacked Yongfeng county, and county magistrate Zhao Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: Guard commander Du Yan and rear-army Yang Shixiong rebelled, attacked Yongfeng, and magistrate Zhao Xun died.

sentences.zh: 金人至太和縣，太后自萬安陸行如虔州。

translations.literal: The Jin reached Taihe; the empress dowager went overland from Wan'an toward Gan.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin reached Taihe; the empress dowager went overland from Wan'an toward Gan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，十詔回浙西迎敵。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: ten edicts ordered return to western Zhe to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, ten edicts ordered return to western Zhe to meet the enemy.

sentences.zh: 金人犯吉州，守臣楊淵棄城走，又陷六安軍。

translations.literal: The Jin attacked Ji prefecture; defender Yang Yuan abandoned the city and fled; they also took Lu'an army.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Ji; defender Yang Yuan fled; they also took Lu'an army.

sentences.zh: 己巳，帝發越州，次錢清鎮。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the emperor left Yue and halted at Qianqing town.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the emperor left Yue and halted at Qianqing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，復還越州。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: he returned again to Yue prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, he returned again to Yue.

sentences.zh: 以周望同知樞密院事，仍兼兩浙宣撫使守平江，殿前都指揮使郭仲荀為副使守越州，右軍都統制張俊為浙東制置使從行。

translations.literal: Zhou Wang was made associate military affairs commissioner, still also two-Zhe pacification commissioner holding Pingjiang; Palace Front commander Guo Zhongxun was deputy commissioner holding Yue; Right Army headquarters commander Zhang Jun was eastern Zhe commissioner following on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Wang became associate military affairs commissioner and still held Pingjiang as two-Zhe pacification commissioner; Palace Front commander Guo Zhongxun was deputy at Yue; Right Army commander Zhang Jun was eastern Zhe commissioner on the journey.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞范宗尹參知政事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Fan Zongyin was made associate administrator of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Fan Zongyin became associate administrator of affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，兀入建康府，守臣陳邦光、戶部尚書李棁迎拜，通判楊邦乂拒之。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Wusu entered Jiankang; defender Chen Bangguang and Revenue Minister Li Zheng welcomed him with obeisance; vice prefect Yang Bangyi refused.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wusu entered Jiankang; defender Chen Bangguang and Revenue Minister Li Zheng welcomed him; vice prefect Yang Bangyi refused.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，帝如明州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the emperor went to Ming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the emperor went to Ming.

sentences.zh: 金人犯建昌軍，兵馬監押蔡延世擊卻之。

translations.literal: The Jin attacked Jianchang army; military controller Cai Yanshi repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Jianchang; military controller Cai Yanshi repelled them.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，兀殺楊邦乂。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Wusu killed Yang Bangyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Wusu killed Yang Bangyi.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠自鎮江引兵之江陰軍。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong led troops from Zhenjiang to Jiangyin army.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong led troops from Zhenjiang to Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 江、淮宣撫司潰卒李選攻陷鎮江。

translations.literal: Jiang-Huai pacification office routed troops under Li Xuan attacked and took Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai pacification routed troops under Li Xuan attacked and took Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 淮丁兵馬都監王宗望以濠州降于金。

translations.literal: Huai militia commander Wang Zongwang surrendered Hao prefecture to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Huai militia commander Wang Zongwang surrendered Hao to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 是月，張浚至秦州。

translations.literal: That month Zhang Jun reached Qin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Jun reached Qin.

sentences.zh: 桑仲自唐州犯襄陽，京西制置使程千秋敗走，仲遂據襄陽。

translations.literal: Sang Zhong from Tang prefecture attacked Xiangyang; Jingxi commissioner Cheng Qianqiu was defeated and fled; Zhong then held Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sang Zhong from Tang attacked Xiangyang; Jingxi commissioner Cheng Qianqiu fled; Zhong then held Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥朔，張浚承制廢積石軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yihai new moon: Zhang Jun by imperial order abolished Jishi army.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yihai new moon: Zhang Jun by imperial order abolished Jishi army.

sentences.zh: 丙子，帝至明州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the emperor reached Ming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the emperor reached Ming.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，江、淮西撫司準備將戚方擁眾叛，犯鎮江府，殺守臣胡唐老。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Jiang-Huai-west pacification office preparation officer Qi Fang led a mutiny, attacked Zhenjiang, and killed defender Hu Tanglao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, pacification preparation officer Qi Fang mutinied, attacked Zhenjiang, and killed defender Hu Tanglao.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金人陷常州，守臣周杞遣赤心隊官劉晏擊走之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Jin took Chang prefecture; defender Zhou Qi sent Red-Heart company officer Liu Yan to strike and drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Jin took Chang; defender Zhou Qi sent Red-Heart officer Liu Yan to strike and drive them off.

sentences.zh: 金人陷廣德軍。

translations.literal: The Jin took Guangde army.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Guangde army.

sentences.zh: 殺守臣周烈。

translations.literal: Defender Zhou Lie was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Defender Zhou Lie was killed.

sentences.zh: 劉光世引兵趨南康軍。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi led troops toward Nankang army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi led troops toward Nankang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，定議航海避兵，禁卒張寶等憚行，謀亂，命呂頤浩等伏兵，執寶等十七人斬之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: it was decided to put to sea to avoid the enemy; garrison troops Zhang Bao and others feared the voyage and plotted mutiny; Lü Yihao and others set an ambush, seized Bao and seventeen others, and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, flight by sea was decided; garrison troops Zhang Bao and others, fearing the voyage, plotted mutiny; Lü Yihao ambushed and beheaded Bao and seventeen others.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張浚承制拜涇原經略使曲端為威武大將軍、宣撫處置使司都統制。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhang Jun by imperial order made Jingyuan commissioner Qu Duan Grand Martial General and headquarters commander of the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhang Jun by imperial order made Jingyuan commissioner Qu Duan Grand Martial General and Pacification headquarters commander.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，兀犯臨安府，守臣康允之棄城走，錢塘縣令朱蹕死之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wusu attacked Lin'an; defender Kang Yunzhi abandoned the city and fled; Qiantang county magistrate Zhu Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wusu attacked Lin'an; defender Kang Yunzhi fled; Qiantang magistrate Zhu Bi died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝乘樓船次定海縣，給行在諸軍雪寒錢。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the emperor boarded a tower ship and halted at Dinghai county; cold-weather cash was given to the mobile-court armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the emperor boarded a tower ship at Dinghai; cold-weather cash was given the mobile-court armies.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，留范宗尹、趙鼎於明州以候金使。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Fan Zongyin and Zhao Ding were left at Ming to await Jin envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Fan Zongyin and Zhao Ding were left at Ming to await Jin envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，帝次昌國縣。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the emperor halted at Changguo county.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the emperor halted at Changguo.

sentences.zh: 乙未，杜彥犯潭州，殺通判孟彥卿、趙民彥。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Du Yan attacked Tan prefecture and killed vice prefects Meng Yanqing and Zhao Minyan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Du Yan attacked Tan and killed vice prefects Meng Yanqing and Zhao Minyan.

sentences.zh: 金人屠洪州。

translations.literal: The Jin massacred Hong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin massacred Hong.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金人犯越州，安撫使李鄴以城降，衛士唐琦袖巨石要擊金帥琶八不克，死之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the Jin attacked Yue; pacification commissioner Li Ye surrendered the city; guardsman Tang Qi hid a great stone in his sleeve intending to strike Jin commander Paba but failed and died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Jin attacked Yue; pacification commissioner Li Ye surrendered; guardsman Tang Qi hid a great stone to strike Jin commander Paba, failed, and died.

sentences.zh: 郭仲荀棄軍奔溫州。

translations.literal: Guo Zhongxun abandoned his army and fled to Wen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhongxun abandoned his army and fled to Wen.

sentences.zh: 庚子，移幸溫、台。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the court moved to Wen and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the court moved to Wen and Tai.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，黃潛善卒于英州。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Huang Qianshan died at Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Huang Qianshan died at Ying.

sentences.zh: 李成自滁州引兵之淮西。

translations.literal: Li Cheng led troops from Chu toward Huai-west.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cheng led troops from Chu toward Huai-west.
